* Incident Management \& RCA: Participating in or leading Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for critical production issues to ensure ongoing system reliability.
* Long\-term Stability: Managing the transition from implementation to ongoing operational support.


**Responsibilities**
* Collaborate with sales and engineering teams to understand customer requirements and develop tailored cloud solutions using Google Cloud Platform services.
* Build strong relationships with key stakeholders and decision\-makers to drive customer success and satisfaction.

* Professional level certification in GCP is required within first 90 days of employment.
* Experience strategizing, designing, architecting, and leading the deployment of scalable solutions on GCP, strongly preferred.

* Experience with the primary managed data services within GCP, including Cloud Bigtable, Cloud Spanner, Cloud SQL, or BigQuery.

* Advocate and demonstrate the value of the Google Cloud and service offerings to prospects.
* India: Willingness to work 12\.30pm to 9\.30pm IST shift for overlap with global team.
* Experience within a Managed Services Provider (MSP) or large\-scale enterprise environment.
* Demonstrated understanding of SLA\-driven service delivery and operational best practices.


***Please note, we cannot sponsor or transfer any visas, of any kind, at this time.***
*66degrees is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to actual or perceived race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, national origin, age, weight, height, marital status, sexual orientation, veteran status, disability status or other legally protected class.*

faa461e5.title: Pre-Sales Solution Architect – AIOps, Observability & Agentic AI-BLR/HYD/NOID/PUN
faa461e5.description:
Role Summary
 



 As Pre\-Sales Solution Architect for AIOps, Observability, and Agentic AI, you will be the technical anchor for client pursuits across our IT Operations transformation portfolio. You will partner with sales, bid management, and delivery teams to translate client pain points into outcome\-driven solutions — architecting AIOps and observability landscapes, embedding Agentic AI into IT operations, and owning the technical solution from RFP response through to delivery handover. You will work OEM\-agnostically across Aisera and comparable enterprise AIOps platforms, positioning the right toolset and integration approach for each client environment.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



**Pursuit \& Solutioning** 



* Lead pre\-sales pursuits (RFPs, RFIs, proactive proposals) across AIOps, Service Assurance, Infra \& Application Monitoring, Event Management, and Automation/Orchestration — including multi\-tower and managed\-services deals.
* Architect end\-to\-end AIOps and observability solutions that ingest, normalize, and correlate high\-volume telemetry (metrics, logs, traces, events) across cloud, on\-prem, and hybrid estates to reduce client MTTD/MTTR.
* Design and embed Agentic AI solutions — autonomous/multi\-agent frameworks, LLM\-powered and function\-calling agents — into enterprise ITSM and IT/Cloud Operations workflows.
* Conduct technical discovery and value\-discovery workshops; convert client SLAs and reliability objectives into measurable SLIs/SLOs.
* Create solution designs, architecture blueprints, effort estimates, scope of work (SoW), and pricing inputs in partnership with sales, bid, finance, and delivery teams.
* Lead OEM/tool evaluations and POCs, balancing features, scale, cost, and integration complexity; leverage OEM partnerships (Aisera, ServiceNow, Dynatrace, Splunk, etc.) for joint pursuits.
* Contribute to order\-booking and revenue targets for the pursuit pipeline; review pricing benchmarks and effort\-estimation models.



**Technical Authority \& Delivery Enablement** 



* Act as the technical SME and trusted advisor in client orals, solution defense, and stakeholder discussions; own objection handling and win\-theme alignment.
* Map client requirements into platform capabilities and a clear implementation roadmap.
* Define, build, and present compelling demos and Proof\-of\-Value (PoV) engagements; maintain reusable demo assets and reference architectures.
* Ensure a clean solution\-to\-delivery handover — transitioning architecture, scope, and assumptions to project/delivery teams for successful execution.
* Build the practice: develop reusable solution accelerators, estimation models, capability decks, and reference documentation; mentor solution and delivery engineers on AIOps patterns and Agentic AI adoption.



 Required Skills \& Experience
 



**ITSM, ITOps \& Platforms (mandatory)** 



* 12–15 years in IT across design, engineering, implementation, and pre\-sales — with 3\+ years in pre\-sales/solutioning of AIOps use cases for enterprise/global clients.
* Strong understanding of IT operations, infrastructure management, and application performance monitoring; sound ITIL foundations.
* Hands\-on experience with ITSM tooling (ServiceNow preferred) and across enterprise AIOps platforms — Aisera, Moogsoft, BigPanda, ServiceNow ITOM/AIOps, HPE OpsRamp, ScienceLogic.
* Scripting (JavaScript or similar), low\-code/no\-code platforms, and hands\-on REST API integration and automation workflow experience.



**Observability, Cloud \& DevOps** 



* Expertise integrating and leveraging data from monitoring/logging/alerting tools — Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK (Elasticsearch/Logstash/Kibana), Splunk, Nagios, Dynatrace, AppDynamics, New Relic, OpenTelemetry.
* Extensive hands\-on experience with at least one major cloud — AWS, Azure, or GCP; working knowledge of containers (Docker, Kubernetes).
* DevOps \& SRE practices and tooling — Ansible, Terraform, Jenkins, Helm, CI/CD pipelines.



**AI / ML / Agentic AI** 



* Understanding of ML for IT Operations — anomaly detection, predictive analytics, event correlation, and automated root\-cause analysis.
* Generative \& Agentic AI fluency: LLMs, embeddings, RAG, prompt engineering, multi\-agent/agent\-orchestration, and LLM\-powered automation (AI workflows / function\-calling).
* Knowledge of RPA/Intelligent Automation (UiPath, Automation Anywhere, Blue Prism) is a plus.



**Pre\-Sales \& Consulting Skills (high weightage)** 



* Proven RFP/proposal ownership, effort estimation, and pricing/benchmarking for large global deals in IT sourcing.
* Ability to drive client and multi\-stakeholder discussions, handle objections, and propose workaround solutions.
* Ability to scope pilots/PoVs, document scope/SoW, and drive them to successful completion.
* Outstanding presentation, storytelling, and consultative selling skills across all levels up to C\-suite; strong, collaborative team player comfortable in a high\-pressure pursuit environment.



 Qualifications
 


* Bachelor’s in Engineering/Technology (mandatory); Master’s (M.S./M.Tech/MBA) preferred.
* ITIL knowledge mandatory, certification desirable; relevant cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP) and platform (ServiceNow, Dynatrace, Splunk) certifications advantageous.
* Willingness to travel for client pursuits.

80e9a6c0.title: Solutions Engineer
80e9a6c0.description:
Key Responsibilities:
 



  





 1\. Solution Design \& Architecture
 



 • Engage with enterprise technology partners, software vendors, and end customers to understand their existing systems and translate requirements into a clear solution architecture.
 



 • Lead integration planning discussions, mapping data flows, defining API specifications, and aligning on technical interfaces between systems.
 



 • Produce solution design documents, architecture diagrams, and data flow maps that both technical and non\-technical stakeholders can act on.
 



 • Work with clients to design deployment configurations, on\-premise, cloud, or hybrid, based on their infrastructure constraints and performance needs.
 



 • Define compute specifications (CPU/GPU, memory, storage), network topology, and infrastructure sizing for each engagement.
 



 • Produce cloud cost estimates and total cost of ownership (TCO) models across AWS, GCP, and Azure.
 



 • Own and respond to RFPs and RFIs, including technical, security, and compliance questionnaires.
 



  





 2\. Hands\-on POC \& MVP Execution
 



 • Build working proofs of concept to validate architecture decisions before full engineering investment, including integration adapters, API bridges, and automation scripts.
 



 • Take POCs through to reference\-quality implementations where appropriate, contributing clean, maintainable code.
 



 • Document findings, limitations, and recommended next steps for every POC.
 



  





 3\. Handover \& Documentation
 



 • Create structured handover packages for product and deployment teams: runbooks, decision logs, open item trackers, and escalation paths.
 



 • Maintain a growing library of reference architectures and integration patterns as reusable assets across engagements.
 



 • Ensure nothing falls through the gap between a sales commitment and a working deployment.
 



  





 4\. Cross\-functional Technical Leadership
 



 • Act as the primary technical liaison between sales, product, engineering, and the client — translating requirements in both directions.
 



 • Identify risks early and propose pragmatic mitigations without stalling progress.
 



 • Feed deployment learnings and client signals back into CARPL's product roadmap discussions.
 



  





 Core Requirements:
 



  





 System Design \& Architecture
 



 • Solid grounding in system design, you can design a distributed system on a whiteboard and then go build it.
 



 • Familiarity with common architecture patterns: microservices, event\-driven architecture, API gateway, CQRS, pub/sub.
 



 • Understanding of how to make tradeoffs between consistency, availability, latency, and cost in real systems.
 



 • Understanding of secure design principles and data protection techniques, including encryption (at\-rest and in\-transit).
 



 • Experience designing and implementing robust access control mechanisms, such as Role\-Based Access Control (RBAC), Single Sign\-On (SSO), and the principle of least privilege.
 



 • Knowledge of vulnerability management, secure coding standards (e.g., OWASP Top 10\), and integrating vulnerability testing into CI/CD pipelines.
 



  





 Hands\-on Engineering
 



 • Proficiency in at least one backend language, Python (preferred), Go, or Java, and the confidence to write production\-quality code without supervision.
 



 • Experience building REST or gRPC APIs, integration adapters, and automation scripts from scratch.
 



 • Comfortable with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and standard DevOps tooling.
 



  





 Databases
 



 • Hands\-on experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) — schema design, query optimisation, indexing.
 



 • Working knowledge of at least one NoSQL store (MongoDB, Redis, Elasticsearch, DynamoDB) and when to use it.
 



 • Understanding of data modelling tradeoffs for operational vs. analytical workloads.
 



  





 Cloud \& Infrastructure
 



 • Practical experience on at least one major cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) including compute, storage, networking, managed services \& cloud firewall and security rules.
 



 • Familiarity with containerisation (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes) in production or near\-production environments.
 



 • Ability to size infrastructure, estimate costs, and build a credible deployment plan for a client.
 



  





 Client\-facing \& Communication
 



 • Strong written and verbal communication: comfortable presenting architecture to a CTO or CPO and explaining tradeoffs to a developer.
 



 • Experience writing technical documentation, RFP/RFI responses, solution proposals, or architecture design documents.
 



 • Skilled at producing clear diagrams (Lucidchart, draw.io, Miro, or similar).
 



  





 Experience
 



 • 2\+ years in solutions architecture, technical pre\-sales engineering, software engineering, or a combination.
 



 • Track record of owning end\-to\-end technical integrations with enterprise or mid\-market clients..
 



 • Experience navigating procurement cycles: security reviews, compliance questionnaires, vendor assessments.
 



  





 Preferred but not mandatory
 



 • DICOM: Working knowledge of DICOM — DIMSE services, DICOMweb (WADO/STOW/QIDO), structured reports, and DICOM node configuration.
 



 • HL7 / FHIR: Familiarity with HL7 v2 messaging and FHIR R4 resources, and how they flow between hospital systems.
 



 • PACS / VNA: Experience working with PACS, VNA, RIS, or HIS systems — ideally in an integration or deployment capacity.

You will guide customers through the competitive landscape, best practices, and implementation, and develop technical champions along the way.

* Collaborate with your fellow Solutions Architects, using your skills to support each other and our users

239268bd.title: Technical Architect
239268bd.description:
**Role Overview** 

Architecture \+ Hands\-on Engineering \+ Technical Leadership

We are looking for a visionary yet hands\-on Technical Architect who can define enterprise\-wide architecture, technology strategy and engineering standards across multiple products and platforms. The role is expected to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions, guide engineering teams, reduce technical risk, and remain actively involved in implementation when required. This is not a purely advisory or documentation role: the Architect may be required to contribute directly to production\-quality code, prototypes, critical modules, technical fixes and architectural proof\-of\-concepts.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define enterprise architecture strategy, target architecture and technology roadmap across products and platforms.
* Design scalable, secure, resilient and maintainable systems aligned with business and product objectives.
* Architect cloud\-native, distributed, microservices and multi\-tenant SaaS solutions.
* Convert product/business requirements into clear architecture, technical designs, service boundaries, data models and API contracts.
* Establish architecture governance, coding standards, engineering best practices, design principles and technical decision records.
* Conduct architecture reviews, design reviews, code reviews and technical risk assessments.
* Identify bottlenecks, scalability concerns, security risks and technical debt, and drive practical remediation plans.
* Drive modernization initiatives, technology evaluation and technical investment decisions.
* Mentor and guide Technical Leads, Senior Engineers and other engineering members.
* Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, QA, DevOps, Security and business stakeholders.
* Support estimation, technical planning, solution feasibility and delivery planning for new products and major features**.**

**Hands\-on Coding \& Engineering Responsibility** 

* The role is explicitly hands\-on. When required by project priorities, the Technical Architect will contribute directly to coding and implementation—not only architecture and reviews.
* Develop production\-quality backend, frontend or integration components where architectural complexity, criticality or delivery timelines require Architect\-level involvement.
* Build technical prototypes, Proofs of Concept (PoCs), reference implementations and reusable frameworks to validate architectural decisions.
* Assist engineers in debugging complex production or development issues and provide root\-cause analysis.
* Contribute to performance optimization, scalability improvements, security fixes and critical technical modules.
* Review and improve existing codebases and guide refactoring/modernization without losing delivery focus.
* Pair with engineers when necessary to transfer architecture decisions into working code and establish implementation patterns**.**
* Remain capable of switching between architecture, design, coding, review and technical troubleshooting based on business/project requirements.

**Core Technical Expertise**

* Programming: JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, **Go (Golang) for minimum 3\-4 years, Java / Spring Boot**
* Architecture: DDD, SOA, API\-First, Distributed Systems, Multi\-Tenant SaaS
* Backend: Node.js, Express.js, Identity, Authentication/Authorization, Messaging
* Data: MongoDB, Redis, Data Modeling, Query/Performance Optimization
* Frontend/Mobile: React.js, React Native AI: LangChain, Gemini, RAG, AI Agents, OCR
* Cloud \& DevOps: AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD
* Security: SSDLC, API Security, Encryption, Governance
* Integrations: WhatsApp Business, Payment Gateways, Enterprise APIs

**Product \& Engineering Expectations**

* Strong understanding of building production\-grade software products rather than isolated applications or proof\-of\-concepts only.
* Ability to balance ideal architecture with business timelines, budget, maintainability and team capability.
* Comfort working in an evolving product\-company environment where requirements may change and multiple initiatives may run in parallel.
* Ability to make pragmatic technology choices and clearly explain trade\-offs to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Ownership mindset: identify problems proactively, propose solutions and follow through until the technical outcome is delivered.
* Strong emphasis on reliability, security, observability, performance, scalability and maintainability from design through production**.**

**Leadership \& Collaboration** 

* Mentor Technical Leads and senior engineers and help establish a strong engineering culture.
* Set clear technical direction without creating unnecessary process or bureaucracy.
* Participate in hiring and technical evaluation of senior engineering candidates when required.
* Help define technical interview standards and assess architecture, coding and problem\-solving capability.
* Work directly with leadership to communicate architecture decisions, technical risks, dependencies and delivery implications.
* Promote documentation of important architecture decisions, APIs, dependencies and operational considerations.

**Preferred Qualifications** 

Experience in FinTech, SaaS, AI platforms, cloud\-native architectures and enterprise\-scale distributed systems**.** 

**Nice to Have**

Kafka, GraphQL, Serverless, Machine Learning Platforms, Multi\-Cloud Architecture.

**What We Expect From the Right Candidate** 

*The ideal candidate is a senior engineer and a kind\-of polyglot architect who can operate at both strategic and implementation levels. You should be comfortable designing the system, explaining why the design is appropriate, guiding the team through it, reviewing the implementation, and writing code yourself when the situation demands it. Candidates looking for a purely managerial, documentation\-only or high\-level advisory architecture role may not be the right fit*

Pay: ₹1,800,000\.00 \- ₹4,000,000\.00 per year

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Baner, Pune, Maharashtra: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

Experience:

* Go Lang: 3 years (Required)
* total: 10 years (Required)

Work Location: In person

**PURPOSE OF THE ROLE** 




 1\. Own the end\-to\-end solution architecture for Axian’s OPCOs, including platforms, tools, core wallet and core banking deployments
 



 2\. Extend the architecture beyond core platforms to the full D\&F technology stack: digital banking, payments, lending (LMS), cards, agent and merchant management, KYC/AML, fraud, data, and customer channels (mobile, USSD, web, API).
 



 3\. Translate business strategy and product roadmaps into scalable, secure, cost\-optimized solution designs — both on\-premise and cloud — that surrounding delivery teams can build against without ambiguity.
 



 4\. Set and enforce architecture standards, integration patterns, and non\-functional requirements across OPCOs; protect the technology estate from fragmentation and ensure compliance with security, data privacy, and regulatory obligations across markets.
 



  





**MAIN FUNCTIONS – RESPONSIBILITIES \& ACTIVITIES** 




  





**Solution \& application architecture across D\&F stack** 




 • Design end\-to\-end solutions for new initiatives and changes spanning core wallet, core banking, payments, LMS, cards, agent/merchant management, KYC/AML, fraud, mobile apps, USSD, APIs, and data platforms.
 



 • Produce target architectures, current\-state assessments, and transition roadmaps for each OPCO and at D\&F group level.
 



 • Define integration patterns, API contracts, event flows, and data models; document with sequence, component, deployment, and data\-flow diagrams.
 



 • Evaluate and select technical frameworks, products, and vendors against business, technical, and commercial criteria.
 



 • Ensure architectural consistency across OPCOs while accommodating local market and regulatory variations.
 



  





**Core platform \& ecosystem architecture** 




 • Own the solution design for deployments, upgrades, and swaps — including data model, integration topology, and migration architecture.
 



 • Architect the surrounding ecosystem: payment gateways, switches, card management, LMS, agent management, KYC/AML, regulatory reporting, CRM, and analytics.
 



 • Partner with the Implementation Manager and OPCO teams during build, test, and cutover to resolve design issues and approve significant changes.
 



 • Drive reuse: build a library of reference architectures, integration patterns, and reusable components that accelerate subsequent rollouts.

 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Telecommunications or equivalent. TOGAF, AWS Certified Solutions Architect (Associate/Professional), Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or equivalent certifications are a strong plus.

 Retail/E\-commerce

2390e7ea.title: Staff Technical Program Manager — Multi-Entity Account Scale & Access Lifecycle
2390e7ea.description:
**Overview**
 Intuit's Identity organization is seeking a Staff Technical Program Manager to focus on how our platform scales for large and complex customers. Our Identity Platform is the primary gateway for millions of customers across TurboTax, QuickBooks, Credit Karma, and Mailchimp — a durable strategic lever that ensures personalized experiences are delivered with world\-class security and compliance.
   

  

 This role sits at the center of one of Intuit's largest growth bets: serving customers whose organizations look nothing like a single\-owner small business. Accounting firms managing hundreds of clients. Multi\-entity businesses running dozens of legal entities across currencies and locations. Mid\-market companies with real hierarchies, real headcount, and real governance requirements. The users you build for are the people your customers employ — the staff, contractors, and accountants they invite into their own Intuit account — and the platform they administer today was designed for a much smaller shape of customer.
   

  

 You will own two initiatives end to end.
 **Scale** 
 is the work of taking our account model from hundreds of entities to thousands, delivering bulk and group\-level administration, and standing up an API\-first surface so customers and partners can manage identity programmatically rather than one user at a time.
 **Access automation** 
 is the work of making the joiner/mover/leaver lifecycle automatic — permissions applied correctly the moment someone is added, revoked the moment they leave, with the audit trail to prove it — collapsing onboarding that takes weeks and eliminating access that outlives the person who held it.
   

  

 We need an AI Native, results\-oriented and empathetic technical leader who can navigate complex system architectures, establish order in ambiguity, and drive technical excellence in a fast\-paced, matrixed environment. This role is based in Bengaluru India and partners daily with the engineering and product teams driving both initiatives.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Drive Technical Excellence: Own and drive two critical identity programs — multi\-entity account scale and automated access lifecycle — from scope definition through launch and adoption. Navigate complex microservice architectures, multi\-tenant account and permission models, and intricate system dependencies to deliver capabilities that are secure, performant, and reliable at scale.
* Own the Scale Initiative: Drive the work of taking our account model from hundreds of entities to thousands — hierarchies, groups, bulk administration, and an API\-first surface so customers and partners can manage identity programmatically rather than one user at a time. Dive deep into the technical subject matter and re\-emerge with an end\-to\-end blueprint the delivery teams can execute against.
* Own the Access Automation Initiative: Drive the joiner/mover/leaver lifecycle to automatic — permissions applied correctly the moment someone is added, revoked the moment they leave, with the audit trail to prove it. Partner with engineering on the provisioning architecture and with product on the administrative experience that sits on top of it.
* Connect Strategy to Execution: Synthesize business strategy, customer signals, and delivery realities to prioritize across both initiatives and keep teams focused on the highest\-impact outcomes. Lead the tradeoff discussions, recommend the execution path, and ensure follow\-through with stakeholders.
* Execute with Rigor: Partner across teams to define program outcomes, build the end\-to\-end delivery plan, and establish the governance model for both initiatives. Develop and drive the operating rhythm — planning, reviews, cutline sessions, and decision forums — that sets direction and instills accountability.
* Own Risks and Dependencies: Both initiatives carry committed dependencies from product teams across Intuit. Uncover risks and dependencies before they materialize, proactively escalate blockers, determine the optimal path to green, and hold partner teams to dated commitments.
* Identity Architecture Partnership: Work with Identity Architects and engineering leaders to ensure account hierarchy, provisioning, and access patterns scale consistently across the Intuit ecosystem, and that both initiatives compose cleanly with the authorization and governance work running alongside them.
* Lead Change Through Migration and Adoption: Own the path from the current account model to the new one — not just the capability, but how existing customers get there without disruption. Identify the impact of key changes, develop the change plan, and exhibit extreme ownership driving from plan to sustained adoption, tracking that customers actually move rather than that the feature shipped.
* Enable Scale and Velocity: Build the frameworks, tooling, and instrumentation that make identity program delivery repeatable — and apply AI agent tools to accelerate program analysis, delivery, and stakeholder communication, evaluating AI\-generated program artifacts with the same rigor applied to human\-generated output.


**Qualifications**
* Experience: 8\+ years in technical program management within platform organizations or high\-scale software development environments, including demonstrated ownership of programs spanning multiple engineering organizations.
* Education: BA/BS in Computer Science, Information Systems, or an equivalent technical degree.
* Identity Platform Depth: Direct experience delivering customer identity and access management (CIAM) capabilities — authentication, authorization, account and organization modeling, or user provisioning and administration — in a product\-facing platform serving external customers at scale.
* Access Model Fluency: Working knowledge of role\- and attribute\-based access control (RBAC/ABAC/PBAC), permission and entitlement models, delegated administration, and the failure modes that come with them — over\-permissioning, role sprawl, and orphaned access.
* Multi\-Tenant Hierarchy Modeling: Experience with systems that represent a customer's own organizational structure — parent/child entities, groups, delegated admins, cross\-organization access — and the design tradeoffs between flexibility and comprehensibility at scale.
* Technical Domain Expertise: Strong grasp of SDLC methodologies, microservices architecture, and platform design, with the systems thinking to form an end\-to\-end blueprint in an unfamiliar problem area and the credibility to be treated as a thought partner by technical stakeholders. Fluency with API\-first delivery, including developer\-facing surfaces and programmatic administration.
* Scale Judgment: Demonstrated experience taking a platform capability from a small\-customer design point to a large\-customer design point, including the migration path for customers already on the old model.
* AI\-Native Delivery: Demonstrated use of AI agents and tools in your own program work to accelerate analysis, structure delivery, and sharpen stakeholder communication — with firsthand judgment about where AI accelerates delivery and where it introduces risk.
* Leadership Style: Proven ability to lead through influence rather than authority, at a scope where you define the program rather than inherit it. Credibility as a boundaryless change leader who drives from plan to sustained adoption. You are a self\-starter who values "Leadership as a Coach" and supports the growth of those around you.
* Communication: Excellent articulate and warm communication skills, with strong written fluency. You can compress a complex program into a page an executive can act on, and simplify technical problems into actionable insight for engineers and leaders alike.
* Problem Solving: Demonstrated ability to establish order in ambiguous situations and use rapid experimentation to learn fast and pivot when necessary.
* Analytical Skills: Strong data\-driven mindset with the ability to track and report on program health, delivery velocity, and customer impact metrics.
* Preferred: Experience with identity standards and protocols (OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, ReBAC/ABAC engines such as OPA); B2B or B2B2C SaaS serving mid\-market or larger customers; experience delivering through partner, reseller, or professional\-services channels.


 Footer
   

  

 Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers \| Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

d76492fa.description:
**Role: Senior Solutions Engineer** 




 Experience: 5\+ Years
 



 Location: Remote
 



  





**Job Summary:** 




 We’re looking for a Senior Solutions Engineer to join our Professional Services team as a trusted technical advisor to global retail brands transforming their in\-store and omnichannel experiences. You’ll be involved from project discovery through execution, working closely with clients, solution partners, and product and engineering teams.
 



 This is a senior individual contributor role for someone with strong development experience who enjoys client\-facing problem\-solving. You’ll own the technical direction of complex implementations and mentor more junior team members. This role reports to the Director of Solution Architecture.
 



  





**What you‘ll do:** 



* Partner with clients and internal delivery teams to gather, validate, and translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Architect solutions leveraging the cloud platform and AWS, integrating with existing eCommerce, POS, Order Management, Fulfillment, and ERP systems.
* Design and implement customizations to core functionality to meet client\-specific business needs.
* Guide client technology teams and solution partners through hands\-on leadership, clear documentation, and technical recommendations.
* Serve as the primary technical point of contact throughout the project lifecycle, from discovery to go\-live.
* Collaborate closely with Product Management and Engineering to align customer needs with platform capabilities and help influence the product roadmap.



  





**What you need to have:** 



* Experience building on serverless and cloud infrastructure, including AWS or similar platforms, as well as working with APIs, event\-driven architectures, and GraphQL.
* Familiarity with retail and commerce systems, including eCommerce, POS/mPOS, OMS, CRM, ERP, and fulfillment platforms.
* A proven track record of client\-facing technical work, including discovery, solution design, and delivery.
* Comfortable working independently in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment with ambiguous requirements.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to effectively translate between business stakeholders and engineering teams.

 Experience: 12 years \+
 



 Location: GNoida,
 



  





 We at Coforge are looking for Service Now Functional Consultants with following skill set

 We are seeking an experienced ServiceNow Consulting \& Solutioning professional to drive end\-to\-end solution design, presales support, consulting engagements, and digital transformation initiatives leveraging the ServiceNow platform. * Develop reusable assets, accelerators, frameworks, and solution offerings.

**About the job**
-----------------



In this role, you will help customers to adopt Google Cloud products. You will lead the adoption of Google Cloud at organizations, guiding them through the technical facts of Google Cloud transformation journey. --------------------

* Develop best practices and assets based on learnings from customer engagements to support initiatives through partners and accelerate Google Cloud adoption.
* Lead solution decomposition exercises to take customer business use cases and translate them into delivery models and Statements of Works (SOWs).
* Collaborate with business and customer engineering to capture customer use cases and requirements. Develop a service strategy for separate accounts and act as the point of contact for services business with the business team.

### **Service Engineer – HVAC Chillers**

### **Experience 3–8 years**

### **Education**

### **Diploma / Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Refrigeration \& Air Conditioning Engineering**

### **Job Summary**

### **The Service Engineer – HVAC Chillers is responsible for installation support, preventive maintenance, breakdown service, troubleshooting, and overhauling of HVAC chiller systems. The role ensures optimal performance, reliability, energy efficiency, and customer satisfaction across assigned customer sites.**

### **Key Responsibilities**

### **Installation \& Commissioning**

* ### **Support installation, commissioning, and start\-up of air\-cooled and water\-cooled chillers**
* ### **Verify system compliance with design specifications and safety standards**
* ### **Coordinate with project teams, contractors, and customers during commissioning**

### **Service \& Maintenance**

* ### **Perform preventive and corrective maintenance of HVAC chiller systems**
* ### **Diagnose and troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, and control system faults**
* ### **Carry out overhauls, compressor servicing, oil analysis, and refrigerant handling**
* ### **Ensure timely closure of service calls and breakdowns**

### **Technical Support**

* ### **Interpret wiring diagrams, P\&IDs, and control logic**
* ### **Calibrate sensors, valves, and control devices**
* ### **Ensure proper operation of pumps, cooling towers, and associated equipment**
* ### **Maintain compliance with OEM guidelines and statutory safety norms**

### **Customer Management**

* ### **Interact with customers professionally and provide technical explanations**
* ### **Prepare service reports, root cause analysis (RCA), and recommendations**
* ### **Upsell AMC, spares, and service upgrades where applicable**

### **Documentation \& Compliance**

* ### **Maintain detailed service records and job reports**
* ### **Follow EHS guidelines, work permits, and safety procedures**
* ### **Support audits and quality improvement initiatives**

### **Key Skills \& Competencies**

* ### **Strong knowledge of HVAC chiller systems (screw, centrifugal, scroll, reciprocating)**
* ### **Hands\-on experience with refrigerants (R134a, R410A, R407C, etc.)**
* ### **Electrical troubleshooting (motors, VFDs, starters, panels)**
* ### **Familiarity with BMS, PLCs, and control systems**
* ### **Analytical and problem\-solving skills**
* ### **Good communication and customer\-handling skills**
* ### **Willingness to travel and work on\-site**

### **Desired Certifications (Preferred)**

* ### **HVAC / RAC Certification**
* ### **OEM Chiller Training (Carrier, Trane, Daikin, York, etc.)**
* ### **Electrical Safety / EHS Certification**

### **Work Conditions**

* ### **Field\-based role requiring travel to customer sites**
* ### **May require working in shifts, weekends, or during emergencies**
* ### **Physically capable of working in plant rooms and industrial environments**

### **Why Join Us?**

* ### **Opportunity to work on advanced HVAC chiller technologies**
* ### **Exposure to premium customers and complex installations**
* ### **Career growth, technical training, and certification opportunities**

**Job Description**
**About the role**
 We are looking for a
 **Senior Solution Architect** 
 to help design and deliver secure, scalable, and cost\-effective technology solutions across our Fleet business. You’ll focus on detailed solution design and technical architecture within specific domains such as consumer\-facing applications, payment systems, card issuing EV, ORS and Fuels transactions processing services.
   

  

 This role is ideal for an experienced Architect who brings strong hands\-on expertise, thrives in delivery\-focused environments and is ready to take ownership of solutions for focused projects or components within larger products/programmes. You will work closely with technical leads, and delivery teams to turn business needs into robust digital solutions.
   

  

**Role Purpose**
 The Senior Solution Architect is responsible for translating business requirements, architectural direction and capability roadmaps into implementable solution designs.
   

  

 Working under the guidance of the Lead Solution Architect, the role supports the delivery of strategic initiatives by producing solution architectures, technical designs and architecture artefacts that align with established standards, target architecture and domain principles.
   

  

 The role acts as the primary architecture partner for delivery teams, supporting feature development, major initiatives, integrations, technology modernisation activities and cross\-system design challenges across a global product landscape.
   

  

 The role is key in enablement and acceleration of the delivery through high\-quality architecture execution and design leadership.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Solution Design \& Delivery Support**
* Lead solution design activities for initiatives, projects and product features.
* Produce end\-to\-end solution designs spanning multiple systems and services.
* Define application interactions, integrations, data flows and service boundaries.
* Ensure solutions align with target architecture and domain standards.
* Support engineering teams throughout design and implementation phases.
* Gain Architecture Governance approval for Solution designs on a TDA


**Architecture Artefacts, Design and Documentation**
 Develop and maintain solution Architecture Documents including: High Level Designs, KDDs (Key Design Decisions), Data Flow Models and Architecture Diagrams, Integration Designs, e2e solution architecture; contribute into strategic roadmaps with Low Level Architecture Inputs, Transition Architecture Inputs.
   

  

 The role is expected to prepare design artefacts and recommendations that are reviewed and approved through architecture governance processes. This role will engage Architecture design authorities for consulting, review and approval of the architecture designs.
   

  

**Collaboration \& Delivery Enablement**
**Role**
 Role will work closely with Product Managers, Business Analysts, SMEs, Technical Leads, Engineering Teams, Platform Teams, UX Designers and Domain architects to:
   

  

* Refine requirements
* Identify architecture impacts
* Assess technical feasibility
* Develop solution options
* Prototype
* Resolve design issues before delivery begins


**Technology \& Standards**
* Apply MACH principles (Microservices, API\-first, Cloud\-native, Headless) and cloud\-native design approaches, ideally with AWS services.
* Ensure foundational elements like security, observability, and integration are built into every solution.
* Work within defined architecture standards, helping to evolve patterns and reusable frameworks


**Governance \& Quality Assurance**
* Present designs at architecture review forums.
* Ensure adherence to architecture standards and patterns.
* Support architecture compliance assessments.
* Identify design risks, gaps and technical debt.
* Escalate architectural concerns to Lead Architects where required.
* Support implementation reviews and design validation activities.


**Strong Candidate Profile should include**
**The Successful Candidate Will Demonstrate**
* Strong hands\-on solution architecture experience.
* Ability to work across multiple products and systems.
* Excellent integration architecture skills.
* Strong documentation and communication abilities.
* Experience producing architecture artefacts and design decisions.
* Ability to support several concurrent initiatives.
* Comfortable working with distributed global teams.
* Strong stakeholder engagement skills.
* Fleet domain knowledge


**Success Measures**
**Success In This Role Would Be Measured By**
* High\-quality architecture deliverables produced on time.
* Reduced ambiguity for engineering teams.
* Increased throughput of architecture engagements.
* Well\-documented and traceable design decisions.
* Compliance with architecture standards and target state direction.
* Successful delivery of cross\-system initiatives.
* Timely enablement of the delivery with design decisions


**Skills \& Capabilities Required**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or equivalent experience.
* At least 8\-10 years in hands\-on solution architecture or technical leadership roles.
* Strong Architecture knowledge of MACH architecture principles, Event\-driven architectures, Relational databases, Distributed systems, Security fundamentals, DevOps concepts, CI/CD practices.
* Deeper knowledge and experience in the following areas will be a plus: AWS, Kafka/Event Streaming, Salesforce, Domain Driven Design (DDD), Identity \& Access Management, Payments platforms, Fleet or mobility solutions
* Proficient in Integration design patterns, API architecture (REST, event\-driven), and microservices.
* Good understanding of Architecture domains (application, data, infrastructure, integration and security).
* Experience designing and delivering solutions using cloud\-native architectures, ideally on AWS.
* Candidate with a proven AI practitioner experience will have a preference


**Behavioural Capabilities**
* Strong Problem Solving – person in this role should be able independently investigate complex business and technical problems and develop pragmatic solution options.
* Strong Collaboration skills to work effectively across Product, Engineering, Business and Delivery teams.
* Influencing Without Authority to guide design direction through expertise and evidence rather than organisational authority.
* Structured Thinking and storytelling to produce clear architecture artefacts, rationale and recommendations.
* Delivery Oriented to balance architectural quality with delivery timelines and business priorities.
* Continuous Learner keeps current with architecture practices, patterns and emerging technologies.


**Why Join Us**
* Shape digital experiences across the Fleet Mobility and Convenience Globally.
* Work with a modern tech stack, experienced architecture teams and global delivery partners.
* Learn and grow in an environment that values technical depth, autonomy and creativity


**About Bp**

We are one of the few companies globally that can provide governments and customers with an integrated energy offering. Delivering our strategy sustainably is fundamental to achieving our ambition to be a net zero company by 2050 or sooner!

* Defines engagements and opportunities to use Intellectual Property (IP) and address product gaps, while leveraging existing IP and community resources to ensure consistency and improve predictability.


**Qualifications**
* 9\-13 years of industry experience with a minimum of 9\+ years of Azure Infrastructure experience
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or equivalent professional experience; advanced technical certifications or higher education preferred.
* Mandatory Microsoft Azure Administrator certification (AZ104\); Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ305\) highly preferred.
* Terraform Associate certification strongly valued, with proven experience in InfrastructureasCode (IaC) automation.
* Cloud AI certification such as Microsoft Azure AI Fundamentals (AI‑900\) or equivalent is a strong advantage, with practical understanding of AI/ML workloads on cloud platforms.
* Experience across both application architecture and cloud infrastructure domains, with the ability to bridge development and operations teams effectively.

* Proficiency in Python for automation, AI integration, and scripting across infra workflows

 Cloud Strategy \& Architecture
   

  

* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft’s Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF).
* Proven experience in designing, implementing, and deploying Azure Landing Zones.


 Landing Zone and Networking
   

  

* Hands\-on experience with Azure IaaS and PaaS services across compute, storage, and networking.
* Expertise in deploying business mission\-critical applications on Azure.
* In\-depth knowledge of Azure networking components including VNet, ExpressRoute, vWAN, ingress/egress patterns, and Network Virtual Appliances (NVAs)


 DevOps \& Automation
   

  

* Proficiency in Azure DevOps, including YAML\-based pipeline configuration.
* Experience with at least one CI/CD platform: GitHub, GitLab, or Jenkins (working knowledge of others is a plus).
* Strong automation skills using ARM templates, Bicep, Terraform, PowerShell, and Azure CLI.
* Experience deploying infrastructure using a modular, reusable approach.


 Multi Cloud Migration \& Modernization
   

  

* Multi\-Cloud Migration experience. Hands\-on experience in AWS or GCP to Azure migration.
* Experience with large\-scale cloud migration projects using tools like Azure Migrate.
* Familiarity with all stages of the migration lifecycle, including assessment, planning, execution, and optimization.
* Experience with container migration and modernization initiatives.


 Infrastructure Security and Zero Trust Practices
   

  

* Strong command of network segmentation, NSGs, Azure Firewall, Private Link, VPN/ExpressRoute security, and Zero Trust networking.
* Implement secure connectivity and encrypted network flows across hybrid and cloud environments.
* Implement Azure Policy, Blueprints, governance guardrails, and secure by design patterns.
* Experience in meeting compliance standards and performing cloud security assessments.
* Deploy secure landing zones following CAF \& WAF (Cloud Adoption Framework \& Well‑Architected Framework) principles ensuring governance, resiliency, and secure adoption paths
* Ensuring alignment with industry frameworks like Zero Trust principles


 Consulting \& Delivery Mindset
   

  

* Strong interest in continuous learning and technical certifications
* Curiosity to explore emerging data and AI technologies
* Willingness to receive feedback, grow technical depth, and expand ownership over time
* Demonstrated success in delivering customer\-facing projects in large\-scale enterprise environments
* Experience conducting technical workshops, envisioning sessions, and solution design engagements.
* Exposure to multiple industries and sectors, with the ability to tailor solutions to diverse business needs.
* Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to engage both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Passion for mentoring, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning.
* Proven adaptability to new technologies and evolving customer requirements.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.


 Embody our culture and values
   

  

 This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.
   

  

 Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. Manages multiple projects collaboratively. Works with HR in recruitment and performance appraisal process. Mentor the team members and layout their growth path.**Role Summary**


Leads the execution and operationalization of enterprise AI initiatives, ensuring AI strategy is translated into scalable, business\-impacting solutions. Partners across business and technology teams to drive delivery, adoption, and measurable outcomes, while maintaining strong alignment to enterprise priorities and governance. Acts as a senior program leader with end\-to\-end accountability for execution, value realization, and executive alignment across priority AI initiatives

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\) Enterprise AI Execution \& Operationalization:** Translate enterprise AI strategy into actionable roadmaps, delivery plans, and implementation milestones**.** Drive end\-to\-end execution of priority AI initiatives across multiple business areas. Ensure AI solutions move from concept to pilot to scaled deployment, and ultimately to sustained adoption. Own delivery outcomes across initiatives, including scope, timelines, and measurable business impact.

**2\) Program \& Portfolio Delivery:** Lead a portfolio of AI use cases and programs across the enterprise. Establish and manage delivery discipline (prioritization, dependencies, timelines, risk mitigation). Ensure outcomes are tied to clear business value (e.g., productivity, growth, cost, risk). Drive integrated program plans, track KPIs and milestones, and proactively manage risks, dependencies, and execution challenges, escalating as needed.

**3\) Cross\-Enterprise Partnership** Partner with Business leaders across functions, Technology, Data \& Analytics team, and Risk, Legal, and Governance teams.Align stakeholders around what gets delivered and how, while shaping execution priorities and ensuring alignment to enterprise AI strategy. Engage senior leaders, including ELT stakeholders, to drive alignment, inform decision\-making, and ensure transparency on progress, risks, and outcomes. Act as a clear point of accountability for progress and results.

**4\) Technical \& Solution Leadership:** Provide informed direction on AI/ML and GenAI solutions to ensure fit\-for\-purpose design.Bridge strategy and execution by helping teams define use cases, select appropriate approaches/models, and ensure scalability and integration. Stay current on emerging AI capabilities and translate into practical application.

**5\) Adoption, Change \& Value Realization:** Drive business adoption of AI solutions, not just delivery. Define metrics and success measures and track realization of expected outcomes. Partner with HR / change / comms teams to support workflow integration and behavior change. Ensure value realization is clearly defined, tracked, and communicated, with a focus on measurable outcomes.

**6\) Governance \& Responsible AI:** Ensure adherence to enterprise AI governance, risk, and compliance frameworks. Operationalize responsible AI practices (e.g., transparency, fairness, controls). Ensure alignment to the enterprise AI operating model, embedding best practices across data, technology, risk, talent, and change management.

**7\) Matrix Team Leadership:** Lead through influence and build strong execution capability and accountability across a broad cross\-functional team. Create consistency in delivery methodologies and standards. Foster a high\-performance, results\-oriented environment; drive clarity, accountability, and continuous improvement across teams.

* Ability to translate strategy into clear, actionable plans and delivered outcomes
* Experience driving adoption and change, ensuring solutions are embedded and delivering business value

* Experience leading large\-scale programs or transformation initiatives with clear accountability for outcomes

**Preferred**

* Background balancing technical depth with program leadership

d44e798d.title: AI Product Delivery Manager
d44e798d.description:
**About Biz4Group** 




 Biz4Group is an AI\-first technology consulting and product engineering company that builds innovative AI\-powered products and enterprise software for startups, SMBs, and Fortune 500 organizations. Our focus is on creating scalable digital products that solve real business problems through AI, automation, and modern engineering.
 



 As we continue to grow, we are looking for an AI Product Manager who can lead end\-to\-end product delivery while transforming client projects into product\-thinking engagements.
 



**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for an AI Product Manager who believes every client engagement should be managed like a product\-not just a project.
 



 You will own the complete product lifecycle, from discovery to deployment, ensuring that customer needs, business goals, AI capabilities, engineering excellence, and delivery execution remain aligned throughout the journey.
 



 The ideal candidate understands that successful delivery is not about completing tasks—it is about creating business outcomes, maximizing customer value, and building scalable solutions.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 Own the complete product lifecycle from discovery to production.
 


* Translate business challenges into product opportunities.
* Define product vision, roadmap, priorities, and success metrics.
* Drive customer\-centric decision\-making throughout development.
* Ensure every delivered feature creates measurable business value.



**Product\-Led Client Delivery** 



* Treat every client project as a product with long\-term scalability and maintainability.
* Shift conversations from feature requests to business outcomes.
* Define product strategy alongside delivery planning.
* Balance customer expectations, engineering constraints, timelines, and business goals.
* Identify opportunities to convert custom solutions into reusable product capabilities.



**AI Product Management** 



* Identify where AI creates measurable business value instead of adding unnecessary complexity.
* Define AI\-powered workflows, intelligent automation, copilots, and AI agents.
* Collaborate with AI engineers to deliver production\-ready AI features.
* Understand LLM capabilities, Agentic AI, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), MCP, and enterprise AI integrations.
* Drive responsible AI adoption across product development.



**Customer Discovery** 



* Conduct discovery workshops with customers.
* Understand user personas, workflows, pain points, and business objectives.
* Gather requirements through structured interviews and stakeholder collaboration.
* Convert ambiguous ideas into clear product requirements.



**Product Strategy** 



* Prioritize features based on business impact and customer value.
* Create product roadmaps aligned with business objectives.
* Define MVPs and incremental release strategies.
* Balance innovation, customer requests, and technical feasibility.



**Delivery Leadership** 



* Work closely with Engineering Managers, Architects, Designers, QA, AI Engineers, and Customer Success teams.
* Manage sprint planning, backlog prioritization, release planning, and product reviews.
* Remove delivery blockers proactively.
* Ensure predictable and high\-quality releases.



**Stakeholder Management** 



* Serve as the primary bridge between customers, engineering, leadership, and business teams.
* Present product updates, roadmap progress, risks, and recommendations.
* Manage expectations through transparent communication.



**Product Analytics** 



* Define and monitor KPIs, product adoption, customer engagement, delivery efficiency, and business outcomes.
* Use data to prioritize product improvements.
* Drive continuous product optimization through customer feedback and analytics.



**Required Skills** 




 Product Management
 


* Product Discovery
* Product Roadmapping
* Backlog Management
* User Story Writing
* PRD Creation
* Feature Prioritization
* Product Strategy
* Customer Journey Mapping
* Agile Product Management
* Design Thinking



**AI Product Expertise** 



* Practical understanding of LLMs and Generative AI.
* Experience working with AI\-powered products.
* Knowledge of AI Agents, MCP, RAG, prompt engineering, and AI automation.
* Ability to define AI use cases that solve business problems.



**Delivery \& Collaboration** 



* Agile and Scrum methodologies.
* Sprint planning and execution.
* Risk management.
* Cross\-functional team leadership.
* Stakeholder communication.
* Vendor and client management.



**Technical Understanding** 




 The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of modern software development, including:
 


* APIs and integrations
* Cloud platforms
* Enterprise software architecture
* AI application lifecycle
* SaaS products
* Web and mobile applications
* Data\-driven products



 Hands\-on coding experience is not mandatory but the ability to communicate effectively with engineering teams is essential.
 



**Required Experience** 



* 6–12 years of experience in Product Management, Technical Product Management, or Digital Product Delivery.
* Proven experience delivering enterprise software products.
* Experience managing AI\-powered or data\-driven products is highly preferred.
* Experience working with global clients.
* Strong understanding of Agile product development.



**What We Look For** 



* Thinks like a Product Owner, not just a Project Manager.
* Customer\-obsessed and business\-focused.
* Strong analytical and strategic thinking.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Comfortable making data\-driven decisions.
* High ownership and accountability.
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-growing, AI\-first organization.
* Passion for innovation and continuous improvement.



**Success Metrics** 




 During your first 12 months, you will be expected to:
 


* Successfully deliver multiple AI\-powered products with high customer satisfaction.
* Improve delivery predictability and reduce project risks.
* Increase customer adoption and product engagement.
* Convert project\-based thinking into product\-led delivery across teams.
* Build reusable product capabilities from client engagements.
* Strengthen collaboration between business, product, design, engineering, and AI teams.
* Drive measurable business outcomes through product decisions.



**Why Join Biz4Group** 



* Build innovative AI\-powered products for global customers.
* Work with cutting\-edge technologies including Generative AI, AI Agents, MCP, automation, and enterprise AI solutions.
* Collaborate with experienced product, engineering, and AI teams.
* Shape the future of AI\-first product development.
* Grow rapidly in a company where innovation, ownership, and execution are valued equally.



 If you believe great delivery comes from great product thinking and you're passionate about building AI\-powered products that create real business impact, we'd love to hear from you.
 



 Required Skills
 



 Stakeholder ManagementProduct ManagementAI Agents / LLM / RAGAgile / ScrumAI Product Management / Generative AIProduct Discovery \& Requirement GatheringSaaS / Enterprise SoftwareCustomer Journey MappingProduct DeliveryProduct Strategy \& Roadmapping

db5732d9.title: Pre-Sales Consultant
db5732d9.description:
**SURYA AT A GLANCE** 
 Surya creates software products and provides implementation services for financial risk management of banks and the financial services industry. We provide web\-based, shared facility treasury management products for corporates. Founded in 1999, Surya’s client base is spread across four continents. We help more than 75\+ banks, hedge funds, and corporations around the world make better business decisions by mitigating risk, enhancing profitability, and complying with regulatory requirements. We are headquartered in Bangalore, India. We also have offices in Dubai, UK, USA and France.
   

  

* Designation: Pre\-Sales Consultant
* Relevant Experience: 2 \- 4 Years
* Qualification: MBA (Finance/Banking), CA, CFA, FRM, B.Com, M.Com, BBM, BE/B.Tech or equivalent qualification


**Roles And Responsibilities**
 As a Pre\-Sales Consultant, you will support business development and sales engagements by understanding client requirements, positioning Surya’s solutions, and demonstrating the value of our products to banks, financial institutions, and corporate customers. The role requires close collaboration with Sales, Product, and Delivery teams across the complete sales lifecycle.
   

  

* Attend client requirement discussions and understand business, functional, and solution needs.
* Conduct product demonstrations, solution walkthroughs, workshops, and presentations for prospective customers.
* Prepare and submit responses for RFPs, RFIs, RFQs, and other proposal\-related documentation.
* Prepare solution decks, product write\-ups, proposal content, business presentations, and customer\-facing collateral.
* Provide content support for certifications, ratings, analyst questionnaires, industry assessments, and related submissions.
* Work collaboratively with Field Sales, Sales Operations, Inside Sales, Product, and Delivery teams to support sales opportunities.
* Assist in solution positioning, proposal preparation, proof\-of\-concept discussions, and customer clarifications.
* Stay updated on banking, financial risk management, regulatory developments, and competitive product offerings.
* Travel to customer locations for meetings, demonstrations, workshops, and business development activities as required


**Required Skills**
*Functional*
* Good understanding of banking and financial services industry.
* Ability to understand customer requirements and map them to product capabilities.
* Exposure to Treasury, ALM, Liquidity Risk, Market Risk, IRRBB, FTP, Basel II/III, Stress Testing, or related risk management areas is desirable.
* Ability to prepare customer\-facing solution proposals, presentations, and business write\-ups.


*Technical*
* Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, and Word – Mandatory.
* Ability to create clear solution decks, product collateral, and proposal documents.
* SQL basics and understanding of databases – Good to have.
* Understanding of enterprise software products and implementation lifecycle is an added advantage.


**Other Essential Skills**
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong presentation, listening, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively across multiple teams.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple opportunities simultaneously.
* Flexible and positive approach to work with willingness to travel based on business requirements.


**Preferred Experience**
* Prior experience in software product pre\-sales, solution consulting, business consulting, or client\-facing product demonstrations.
* Prior exposure to Financial Risk Management products or banking product pre\-sales will be an added advantage.
* Experience working with banks, financial institutions, NBFCs, fintech organizations, or enterprise software companies is preferred

98da0e2a.title: Presales Solutions Architect - SME
98da0e2a.description:
At Check Point, what you do matters. Every day, we protect over 100,000 organizations worldwide from increasingly sophisticated cyber and AI\-driven threats, securing their AI transformation.
 



 Our prevention\-first approach safeguards hybrid networks, cloud environments, digital workspaces, and AI systems, stopping attacks before they happen.
 



  





 This is where innovation meets real\-world impact. You’ll help customers across industries operate with confidence in a rapidly changing digital world, working alongside smart, curious people who take ownership, challenge assumptions, and solve complex problems.
 



 We’re proud to be recognized by TIME, Newsweek, and Forbes for excellence and workplace culture.
 



  





 What really sets Check Point apart is the opportunity to grow, contribute, and help companies navigate their AI transformation securely.
 



  





 If you’re excited to work at the forefront of AI\-driven security on a global scale, this is the place to do it
 



  





**Overview**




 We are seeking a senior, customer\-facing Cybersecurity Lead Technologist to act as the regional Subject Matter Expert and technical evangelist for Check Point across India. You will drive technical strategy, lead complex solution design and POCs, influence product roadmaps, and accelerate large strategic deals while representing Check Point to customers, partners, and industry forums.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities**




  




* Serve as the regional technical SME and trusted advisor for strategic customers, engaging across C\-level, Security Architects, DevOps, cloud and application teams.
* Lead design and architecture of complex network and security solutions, partnering with Systems Engineering to translate customer requirements into operational plans.
* Deliver hands\-on demonstrations, custom POCs/POVs, and technical workshops to validate solutions and drive adoption.
* Influence product roadmaps by articulating field requirements to Product Management, R\&D, and Engineering.
* Identify and accelerate upsell/cross\-sell opportunities and support achievement of seven\-figure deals.
* Evangelize Check Point solutions at conferences, webinars, and customer events; create technical content (blogs, videos, webinars).
* Mentor and enable SE teams; develop training materials and ensure smooth handover of technical solutions.
* Monitor competitive landscape and industry trends (Zero Trust, Cloud, Endpoint, IoT, AI/ML, Threat Intel, Incident Response), and drive competitive strategies.
* Define success metrics, operationalize initiatives, and report progress using data\-driven insights.



  






 Qualifications
 




  




* 15\+ years in cybersecurity, network engineering, or systems engineering with strong customer\-facing experience.
* Demonstrated ability to influence C\-level and technical stakeholders and win large strategic opportunities.
* Deep expertise across network security, Zero Trust, cloud security, endpoint, IoT, threat intelligence, and incident response.
* Hands\-on skills: solution architecture, POC delivery, CLI usage, CLI automation, and rack\-and\-stack level design.
* Experience with scalable, distributed systems and tiered application/network load balancing across public and private clouds.
* Proven content creation and thought leadership: speaker at conferences/meetups, blogs, webinars, podcasts.
* Strong communicator in English (written and verbal); excellent presentation and facilitation skills.
* Comfortable working in a matrixed environment and driving cross\-functional initiatives.
* Industry certifications in cybersecurity (e.g., CISSP, CCSP, vendor certs) preferred.
* Willingness to travel up to 40%.



  





**Why Join Check Point** 



* Work with market\-leading cybersecurity technologies and influence product direction.
* High\-visibility role with opportunities to shape strategic accounts and make measurable impact.
* Culture of continuous learning, collaboration, and career growth.
* Competitive package and opportunities to lead innovative programs and customer outcomes.

16c866a5.title: Senior Cloudflare Solutions Engineer
16c866a5.description:
We are seeking a hands\-on Senior Cloudflare Solutions Engineer to design, build and deploy a production\-ready Cloudflare Workers transparent proxy and edge\-security perimeter for an enterprise search platform.

The engagement will address client\-side API\-key exposure, restore accurate client\-IP analytics and implement Cloudflare WAF, Advanced Rate Limiting and bot protection to defend the platform against AI scraping, automated traffic and quota abuse.

Key Responsibilities

\* Design and develop a secure transparent proxy using Cloudflare Workers.

\* Route browser\-based search requests securely through the Cloudflare edge.

\* Prevent direct exposure or misuse of third\-party search API credentials.

\* Implement secure API\-key handling and server\-side request validation.

\* Preserve accurate client\-IP information for analytics, security monitoring and rate limiting.

\* Prevent spoofing or manipulation of forwarded client\-IP headers.

\* Configure Cloudflare WAF, custom rules and managed rulesets.

\* Implement Cloudflare Advanced Rate Limiting across IP, session, endpoint and behavioural attributes.

\* Design bot and abuse controls to mitigate AI scraping and automated traffic.

\* Implement request filtering, header manipulation, origin protection and secure routing.

\* Restrict permitted API methods, indexes, endpoints and request parameters.

\* Configure logging, monitoring, alerting and security\-event visibility.

\* Support development, testing, UAT and production deployment.

\* Establish CI/CD, configuration management and rollback procedures.

\* Conduct performance, security and failure testing.

\* Troubleshoot Cloudflare, DNS, TLS, caching, routing and origin\-connectivity issues.

\* Prepare architecture diagrams, configuration documentation, operating procedures and handover materials.

\* Collaborate with product, security, cloud and application teams.

\* Provide knowledge transfer to internal technical teams.

Mandatory Experience

\* Strong hands\-on experience developing and deploying \*Cloudflare Workers\* using JavaScript or TypeScript.

\* Demonstrated experience building reverse proxies, transparent proxies or API gateways at the edge.

\* Strong experience with Cloudflare WAF and custom firewall rules.

\* Hands\-on experience with Cloudflare Advanced Rate Limiting.

\* Experience implementing Cloudflare Bot Management or equivalent bot\-mitigation controls.

\* Strong understanding of HTTP/S, DNS, TLS, REST APIs, headers, cookies and caching.

\* Experience with secure API\-key, token and credential\-management patterns.

\* Experience preserving trusted client\-IP information through proxies and CDN layers.

\* Strong application and API\-security knowledge, including OWASP Top 10 and OWASP API Security.

\* Experience protecting public APIs from scraping, credential abuse, automated traffic and denial\-of\-wallet attacks.

\* Production deployment and troubleshooting experience in enterprise environments.

\* Ability to produce clear technical designs, operational documentation and knowledge\-transfer materials.

Highly Desirable

\* Experience integrating Cloudflare Workers with \*Algolia\* or a similar hosted search platform.

\* Understanding of Algolia search keys, secured API keys, indexes, analytics and usage quotas.

\* Experience using Cloudflare API Shield, Turnstile, Zero Trust, KV, D1, Durable Objects or Queues.

\* Infrastructure\-as\-Code experience using Terraform.

\* CI/CD experience using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps or similar platforms.

\* Experience with Cloudflare Logpush, SIEM integration and security analytics.

\* Experience protecting services from generative\-AI crawlers and sophisticated scraping tools.

\* Cloudflare certifications or formal Cloudflare partner training.

\* Experience delivering solutions within regulated or security\-sensitive organisations.

Expected Deliverables

\* Current\-state review and confirmed technical requirements.

\* Solution architecture and detailed implementation design.

\* Production\-ready Cloudflare Workers transparent proxy.

\* Secure API\-key and request\-validation controls.

\* Trusted client\-IP preservation and analytics solution.

\* Cloudflare WAF and custom security rules.

\* Advanced Rate Limiting policies.

\* Bot, AI\-scraping and automated\-abuse protection.

\* Logging, monitoring and alerting configuration.

\* Test plan and evidence covering functionality, security and performance.

\* Deployment, rollback and operational runbooks.

\* Knowledge\-transfer sessions and final handover documentation.

Engagement Requirements

The successful consultant must be available for up to \*20 hours per week over six weeks\* and be capable of working independently while collaborating with the customer’s product and technology teams.

Candidates must provide examples of Cloudflare Workers solutions they have personally designed and coded. Shortlisted applicants may be asked to complete a practical technical assessment covering proxy development, header handling, rate limiting and bot mitigation.

Pay: ₹487,677\.24 \- ₹1,671,576\.33 per year

Work Location: Remote

b0425d8b.description:
As an **Enterprise Network Architect – Infrastructure \& DDI**, you will design and oversee the implementation of secure, scalable, and regionally integrated network infrastructure across offices. This strategic role combines deep technical expertise with hands‑on design ownership, ensuring enterprise connectivity, resilience, and compliance.


### **What You’ll Do and How You’ll Succeed**


**Network Architecture \& Design**


* Architect and document enterprise LAN/WAN infrastructure including core/access switching (Cisco C9300/C9200\), WAN edge routing (Cisco C8300/C8200\), VLANs, and IP segmentation.
* Design and implement SD‑WAN architecture with multi‑region integration (Americas, EMEA, APAC).
* Define HA, redundancy, and failover strategies across routing, switching, and WAN links.

**Wireless \& Access Infrastructure**


* Design and standardize Wi‑Fi networks (Cisco Catalyst 9100, 9800 WLC).
* Integrate identity‑based VLAN assignment using Cisco ISE/NPS with 802\.1X/EAP‑TLS.
* Optimize wireless coverage, RF planning, and dynamic AP load balancing.

**DDI (DNS, DHCP, IPAM)**


* Architect and deploy Infoblox DDI solutions (Grid Master/Members, HA).
* Integrate DHCP/DNS services with IPAM, ISE, and Active Directory.
* Define IP address management schema, subnet design, and discovery policies.

**Security \& Policy Integration**


* Collaborate with security teams on firewall integration and policy routing.
* Implement secure dynamic VLANs and posture‑based access via Cisco ISE.
* Define network zoning, segmentation, and east‑west traffic controls.

**Documentation \& Standards**


* Produce HLDs, LLDs, implementation plans, and As‑Built documentation.
* Establish configuration standards, naming conventions, and operational runbooks.

### **We’d Love to Hear From You If..****.**


**Experience**


* You have 15\+ years of enterprise network engineering/architecture experience.
* You have proven expertise in designing multi‑site, multi‑region enterprise networks.
* You have strong understanding of 802\.1X, EAP‑TLS, RADIUS, and certificate‑based authentication.
* You have experience with SD‑WAN solutions (Cisco SD‑WAN/Meraki/Viptela preferred).

**Technical Expertise**


* You have deep hands‑on expertise with Cisco enterprise routing/switching (Catalyst 9K, IOS‑XE).
* You are skilled with Cisco WLCs (9800 series) and Wi‑Fi 6 APs.
* You have experience with Cisco ISE or Microsoft NPS for identity‑based access.
* You are proficient with Infoblox or similar DNS/DHCP/IPAM solutions.
* You know BGP, OSPF, HSRP, VRRP, and Policy‑Based Routing.

**Ways of Working**


* You demonstrate strong documentation and presentation skills.
* You lead design workshops and interface effectively with global stakeholders.
* You are proactive, structured, and capable of driving complex technical decisions.

**Preferred Certifications**


* CCNP Enterprise or CCIE (Routing \& Switching / Enterprise Infrastructure).
* Infoblox Core DDI Certified (CDCA/CDIA).
* Cisco Certified Specialist – Enterprise Wireless Design.
* Microsoft or Cisco security certifications (advantage).
