**Job Listing Detail**
 At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture, and technology to become the best version of you. We’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We’re looking for a Manager in our Cyber Security team with a strong focus on Cloud Security Architecture. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, governing, and assuring secure cloud and hybrid architectures, enabling organizations to adopt and scale cloud technologies securely across IaaS, PaaS, SaaS, and cloud native platforms.
   

  

 You will work with global clients to define secure cloud landing zones, reference architectures, and security by design patterns, supporting large scale cloud transformation, modernization, and migration programs while addressing evolving cyber, regulatory, and business risks.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Design and define cloud security architectures for hybrid and multi cloud environments across Azure, AWS, and GCP.
* Develop secure cloud reference architectures and landing zone designs, incorporating identity, network segmentation, encryption, logging, monitoring, and governance controls.
* Lead cloud security architecture reviews and design assurance activities for client cloud programs.
* Apply Zero Trust Architecture principles across cloud, identity, network, and workload layers.
* Architect security controls for cloud native services, including containers, Kubernetes, serverless, and PaaS offerings.
* Oversee the integration of cloud native security services such as CSPM, CWPP, CIEM, CASB, and cloud native SIEM/SOAR.
* Conduct cloud threat modeling and risk assessments, addressing shared responsibility models and platform specific risks.
* Support secure adoption of DevSecOps practices, including infrastructure as code (IaC) and policy as code.
* Review and assess cloud configurations for compliance with organizational standards, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.
* Collaborate with enterprise security architecture, data, privacy, and AI teams to ensure end to end security alignment.
* Engage senior client stakeholders to align cloud security strategy with business objectives and risk appetite.
* Mentor and guide junior consultants and architects, fostering strong cloud security capabilities.
* Contribute to solution development, go to market assets, RFPs, and proposals.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Strong experience in cloud security architecture and design.
* Deep understanding of cloud shared responsibility models and defense in depth.
* Strong knowledge of identity centric security, network security, encryption, and key management in cloud environments.
* Experience securing cloud native workloads (containers, serverless, PaaS).
* Familiarity with CSPM, CWPP, CIEM, CASB, and cloud native security tooling.
* Strong understanding of Zero Trust Architecture in cloud contexts.
* Ability to translate complex cloud security risks into clear, actionable guidance.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple engagements in a fast paced consulting environment.


**To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have**
* 10–14 years of experience in Information Technology, with specialization in Cloud and Cyber Security.
* Proven experience designing and reviewing cloud security architectures across Azure, AWS, and/or GCP.
* Hands on exposure to cloud IAM, network security, encryption, logging, and monitoring services.
* Experience implementing or integrating cloud security tooling (CSPM, CWPP, CIEM).
* Experience supporting cloud risk assessments, architecture reviews, and transformation programs.
* Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, Azure/AWS/GCP Security certifications, or equivalent.


**Ideally, You’ll Also Have**
* Experience working in a consulting or professional services environment.
* Exposure to multi cloud and hybrid cloud operating models.
* Familiarity with DevSecOps, IaC, and CI/CD security practices.
* Experience aligning cloud security with privacy, data protection, and regulatory requirements.
* Strong interpersonal skills and ability to build trusted client relationships.
* A proactive mindset toward emerging cloud security threats and innovations.


**What We Look For**
* Professionals with strong cloud architecture depth and consulting mindset.
* Ability to lead cloud security discussions with CISOs, CTOs, Cloud Architects, and senior stakeholders.
* Comfort working across technology, risk, and business teams.
* Experience supporting RFP responses, proposals, and solution shaping is a plus.
* Passion for enabling secure, scalable, and resilient cloud adoption.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

28637622.description:
**Job Description**
 Role Summary
   

  

 The Service Desk Delivery Lead is accountable for end\-to\-end delivery of Service Desk operations across one or more client engagements, ensuring contractual SLAs, customer satisfaction, and operational excellence. This VP\-level role owns the P\&L, governance, and strategic relationship for assigned accounts, acting as the primary escalation point between the client and internal delivery teams.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Delivery \& Operations
   

  

* Own end\-to\-end Service Desk delivery (L1/L2 support) across assigned client accounts, ensuring SLA/KPI adherence (response time, resolution time, CSAT, FCR, abandonment rate)
* Drive operational reviews (daily/weekly/monthly) to track performance, capacity, and quality metrics
* Lead incident, problem, and major incident management processes in line with ITIL best practices
* Ensure staffing, shift planning, and resource utilization align with contracted volumes and seasonality


 Client \& Stakeholder Management
   

  

* Serve as the primary point of contact for client stakeholders on delivery matters; build trusted, long\-term relationships
* Lead governance calls, QBRs, and steering committee meetings, presenting performance, risks, and improvement plans
* Manage escalations, ensuring timely resolution and root\-cause communication to clients
* Identify and pursue account growth opportunities (upsell/cross\-sell) in partnership with sales/account management


 P\&L and Commercial Ownership
   

  

* Own the delivery P\&L for assigned engagements, managing costs, margins, and productivity targets
* Support contract renewals, pricing discussions, and commercial negotiations
* Track and report utilization, attrition, and cost\-to\-serve metrics


 Process Improvement \& Transformation
   

  

* Drive continuous improvement initiatives (automation, self\-service, knowledge management, AI/chatbot deployment) to improve efficiency and reduce cost\-to\-serve
* Champion adoption of ITSM tools (ServiceNow, Remedy, Jira Service Management, etc.) and reporting/analytics platforms
* Benchmark performance against industry standards and lead maturity assessments


 Team Leadership
   

  

* Lead, mentor, and develop a multi\-layered team (Team Leads, Shift Managers, Analysts) across geographies
* Build succession plans and drive engagement, retention, and capability\-building initiatives
* Foster a culture of accountability, customer\-centricity, and continuous learning


 Risk, Compliance \& Governance
   

  

* Ensure adherence to information security, data privacy, and client\-specific compliance requirements
* Support audits (internal/external) and ensure timely closure of findings


**Required Qualifications \& Experience**
* 15\+ years in IT service desk / infrastructure support delivery, with 5\+ years in a leadership/P\&L\-owning role
* Proven experience managing large, multi\-shift service desk operations (500\+ FTEs preferred) for global clients
* Strong background in ITIL processes (Incident, Problem, Change, Major Incident Management); ITIL certification preferred
* Demonstrated experience in client relationship management at senior stakeholder level (CIO/IT Director)
* Experience driving automation/AI\-led transformation in service desk operations
* Bachelor's degree required; MBA or equivalent management qualification preferred


 Skills \& Competencies
   

  

* Strong executive presence and stakeholder management skills
* Data\-driven decision making; comfort with dashboards, SLA reporting, and analytics
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and conflict\-resolution skills
* Ability to manage ambiguity and multiple concurrent client engagements
* Strong commercial acumen and P\&L management experience


 Key Metrics of Success
   

  

* SLA/KPI compliance across engagements
* Client CSAT/NPS scores
* Delivery margin and cost\-to\-serve improvement
* Employee engagement and attrition rates
* Successful contract renewals and account growth

**Job Description \& Summary:**

We are looking for an **Infrastructure Engineer** to join our **Azure** ‑ **first Global Capability Center (GCC)** . This role is responsible for operating, optimizing, and modernizing **enterprise and cloud infrastructure** , with a strong focus on **Microsoft Azure and hybrid environments** supporting global business platforms.


The engineer will work closely with global IT, cloud, security, and application teams to ensure **availability, scalability, security, and operational excellence** across production environments.

**Azure \& Hybrid Infrastructure Operations**

* Operate and support **Azure infrastructure services** including VMs, Storage, Networking, and identity services
* Manage **hybrid infrastructure** integrating on ‑ prem systems with Azure cloud
* Ensure **high availability, performance, backup, and disaster recovery** for business ‑ critical workloads
* Provide **L3/L2 infrastructure support** , including incident, problem, and change management
* Participate in **on** ‑ **call rotations** supporting global 24x7 environments
**Cloud Platform \& Modernization**

* Support and maintain **Azure subscriptions, resource groups, networking, and access control**
* Execute and support **cloud migration and infrastructure modernization** initiatives
* Monitor infrastructure health using **Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and alerting tools**
* Drive **capacity planning, cost optimization, and performance tuning**
**Automation \& Infrastructure as Code**

* Automate infrastructure provisioning and operations using **Terraform, ARM templates, or Bicep**
* Develop scripts using **PowerShell, Bash, or Python**
* Improve operational efficiency through **standardization and self\-service tooling**
**Security, Compliance \& Governance**

* Implement **patching, hardening, backup, and DR** best practices
* Support **security controls, audits, and compliance requirements**
* Follow enterprise **change, risk, and release management** processes
**Collaboration \& GCC Ownership**

* Work closely with **global cloud, network, security, and application teams**
* Create and maintain **SOPs, runbooks, and infrastructure documentation**
* Act as an **Azure infrastructure SME** within the GCC
**Mandatory skill sets:**

**Core Infrastructure Skills**

* Strong experience in **Infrastructure / Systems / Cloud Engineering** roles
* Hands ‑ on expertise with:
* **Windows \& Linux servers**
* **Virtualization** (VMware / Hyper ‑ V)
* **Storage, Backup, and DR solutions**
* **Networking fundamentals** (DNS, Load Balancers, Firewalls, TCP/IP)
**Azure \& Tooling**

* Strong hands ‑ on experience with **Microsoft Azure** , including:
* Azure VMs, VNets , NSGs, Load Balancers, Azure Storage
* Azure Monitor, Log Analytics
* Azure AD / Entra ID basics
* Experience with **Infrastructure as Code** (Terraform, ARM, Bicep)
* Familiarity with **ITSM tools** , monitoring, and alerting platforms
**Professional Skills**

* Strong troubleshooting and **root cause analysis** skills
* Ability to operate in **global** **,** **follow** ‑ **the** ‑ **sun** **delivery models**
* Clear communication and documentation skills
**Preferred skill sets:**

* Experience working in a **Global Capability Center (GCC)**
* Exposure to **Azure Landing Zones** , enterprise\-scale Azure setups
* Knowledge of **DevOps / automation\-first infrastructure practices**
* Azure certifications (AZ ‑ 104, AZ ‑ 305, etc.)
* Experience supporting **large\-scale enterprise platforms**
**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to work on **global Azure\-first platforms**
* Strong learning environment focused on **cloud and modernization**
* Clear growth paths into **Cloud Engineering, Platform, SRE, or Architecture** roles

4 \-8 Years

Btech BE

6c10feab.description:
**Job Title:** Solution Engineer – Facility Engineering

**Job Level:** E1 / E2

**Department:** Facility Solution Engineering

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

**Job Purpose**

The **Solution Engineer** will design, cost, and execute technical solutions for facility utilities, HVAC, thermal, and fluid systems. This role bridges customer requirements with engineering execution by developing detailed technical proposals, preparing Bills of Quantities (BOQ), selecting core equipment, and collaborating with cross\-functional teams and vendors to support business growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Solution Design \& Engineering Sizing**

* Perform thermal, fluid, and pressure\-drop calculations to size equipment, piping, pumps, chillers, and cooling towers.
* Design and evaluate support structures, skids, and facility layouts for chilled water, cooling water, fuel, and HVAC systems.
* Use 2D/3D drafting tools (AutoCAD, SolidWorks, SketchUp) to prepare process flow diagrams, P\&IDs, and layout schemes.

**Proposal Development \& Costing**

* Analyze customer RFQs, tender specifications, and technical scope requirements.
* Develop detailed Bills of Materials (BOM) and Bills of Quantities (BOQ) along with line\-item cost estimates.
* Prepare comprehensive technical proposals, bidding documents, and value\-engineered alternatives.

**Vendor \& Stakeholder Management**

* Interface with suppliers to evaluate component options, obtain commercial offers, and assist in technical negotiations.
* Conduct site visits to assess customer facilities, gather field data, and attend pre\-bid technical clarification meetings.
* Coordinate with internal engineering, sales, procurement, and project execution teams to deliver viable solutions.

**Qualifications \& Prerequisites**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s Degree (B.E. / B.Tech) in Mechanical Engineering.
* **Experience:** 1 to 3 years of hands\-on experience in facility solution engineering, utility sales support, or thermal/fluid system design.

**Required Skills \& Competencies**

* **Core Technical:** Strong grasp of fluid mechanics, heat transfer, psychrometrics, pump selection, and pipe sizing.
* **Software:** Proficiency in **AutoCAD (2D Drafting)** and MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word). Experience with **SolidWorks** or **SketchUp** is a plus.
* **Commercial Acumen:** Understanding of BOQ/BOM preparation, vendor negotiation, and cost optimization strategies.
* **Communication:** Clear written and verbal communication skills in English; ability to present technical solutions to client stakeholders.
* **Attributes:** Self\-driven, collaborative, detail\-oriented, and customer\-focused.

Pay: ₹600,000\.00 \- ₹700,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects, championing an AI\-First Delivery \& Engineering methodology by utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation
* Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed, utilizing AI coding assistants to help enforce standards and optimize code performance
* Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation, championing the team's use of tools like GitHub Copilot to accelerate the generation of Apex classes, mock data, and REST integrations
* Focus on Performance Evaluation \& ROI by collaborating with customers to develop evaluation frameworks to measure AI performance and business value for their specific use cases
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues, leveraging AI diagnostics to interpret system logs and isolate performance bottlenecks quickly
* From time\-to\-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre\-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep\-dive sessions, Proof\-Of\-Concept (POC) development with prospects using AI tools to build prototypes rapidly
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50\-75%


**You're Our Person If...**
* Degree or equivalent proven experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core proficiencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* 9\-14 years CRM experience with a minimum of 6 years on the Salesforce platform
* Expert level understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Community, Marketing, and Community Clouds, as well as an understanding of Agentforce architecture
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance\-driven solutions, including using AI platforms to evaluate architectural scaling and load limits
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices, with experience using AI tools to model data distribution and analyze potential data skew risks
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth) and how to configure them securely
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.), utilizing AI platforms to parse third\-party REST API documentation and map complex data schemas
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Practical fluency using AI coding assistants and modern development ecosystems (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, Claude) to accelerate delivery, document technical architecture, and maintain a high standard of code quality
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end\-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
* Strong background in design/development of large web\-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire.

76f4aa24.description:
**WorkNEXT AI Transformation Head**
**Role Summary**
 The WorkNEXT AI Tech Expert is the technical ambassador for WorkNEXT AI modules—owning end\-to\-end client engagement, discovery, solution design, demos, pilots, and technical enablement. This role translates business pain points into pragmatic AI solutions, drives adoption and outcomes, and partners with product, engineering, and customer success to ensure WorkNEXT deployments deliver measurable value at scale.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Client Engagement \& Solutioning**
* Lead technical conversations with enterprise clients: discovery, requirements analysis, solution architecture, and value mapping.
* Conduct tailored demos and hands\-on workshops for WorkNEXT AI modules (e.g., workflows, assistants, analytics, automation).
* Design proof\-of\-concepts (POCs) and pilot plans, including success criteria, data readiness, and deployment approach.
* Translate business needs into AI\-driven use cases and solution designs (incl. integrations, data pipelines, governance).


**Technical Ownership**
* Build reference architectures and implementation playbooks for WorkNEXT AI modules across common enterprise stacks.
* Partner with engineering to scope features, validate feasibility, and drive technical issue resolution.
* Configure and optimize WorkNEXT AI models and workflows (prompt strategies, orchestration, guardrails, evaluation).
* Ensure compliance with security, privacy, and responsible AI standards; coordinate with InfoSec and legal teams.


**Customer Success \& Enablement**
* Create client\-facing technical collateral: solution briefs, runbooks, FAQs, architecture diagrams, ROI calculators.
* Train client admins and super\-users; develop enablement plans and adoption campaigns.
* Monitor post\-deployment health: performance metrics, drift, model evaluation, user feedback loops.


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**
* Capture client feedback and market signals to inform product roadmap and prioritization.
* Collaborate with Sales/Pre\-Sales for deal strategy, estimates, and RFP responses.
* Work with Data Engineering and Integration teams to ensure robust pipelines and API/connector reliability.


**Required Skills \& Competencies**
**Technical**
* Strong understanding of AI/ML foundations: NLP, LLMs, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), prompt engineering, model evaluation.
* Experience with cloud platforms (Azure/AWS/GCP), containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and API integration patterns (REST, GraphQL, webhooks).
* Knowledge of data pipelines (ETL/ELT), vector databases/embeddings, and observability of AI systems.
* Familiarity with enterprise security, compliance, and responsible AI (RBAC, PII handling, auditability, human\-in\-the\-loop).
* Ability to create architecture diagrams, deployment runbooks, and performance monitoring strategies.


**Client\-Facing**
* Exceptional communication—can simplify complex AI concepts for non\-technical stakeholders.
* Consultative approach—discovery, problem framing, value story, and objection handling.
* Strong demo presence; comfortable tailoring demos to industry verticals and role personas.
* Negotiation and stakeholder management across business, IT, InfoSec, and procurement.


**Mindset**
* Outcome\-oriented: focuses on measurable business impact, not just features.
* Curious and experimental: rapid prototyping, A/B testing, iterative improvement.
* Ownership and accountability: proactive risk management, transparent communication.


**Qualifications**
* 6–10\+ years in Client\-Facing Technical roles (e.g., Solutions Architect, Pre\-Sales Engineer, AI Consultant).
* 3\+ years hands\-on with AI/ML, LLM applications, or automation platforms.
* Bachelor’s/Master’s in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* Experience in at least one enterprise vertical (e.g., BFSI, Manufacturing, Retail, Healthcare) is a plus.
* Certifications in cloud/AI (Azure AI Engineer, AWS ML Specialty, GCP ML Engineer) preferred.


**Typical WorkNEXT AI Use\-Case Areas (Adjust to your modules)**
* Knowledge assistant with RAG for policy/SOP retrieval, multilingual Q\&A.
* Process automation: ticket triage, claim summarization, email drafting, task routing.
* Insight generation: summarization of meetings/chats, trend analysis, risk alerts.
* Employee experience: HR policy assistant, IT helpdesk copilot, onboarding flows.
* Compliance \& governance: redaction, PII detection, audit\-ready conversation logs.


**Tools \& Tech Stack (Illustrative)**
* Cloud \& Infra: Azure (OpenAI, Cognitive Search), AWS (Bedrock, Sagemaker), GCP (Vertex AI).
* Data: Databricks/Snowflake/BigQuery; ETL tools (ADF, Airflow), vector stores (Pinecone, FAISS).
* Integration: REST/GraphQL APIs, iPaaS (MuleSoft, Boomi), event buses (Kafka).
* Observability \& Evaluation: Prometheus/Grafana, MLflow, human eval tooling, prompt/version management.
* Security: OAuth2/OIDC, RBAC, KMS, DLP; Responsible AI guardrails \& content filters.

55c049d7.description:
**About Northern Trust**

  

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.  



  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.  



  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.  



  

  

**Senior Lead, Anaplan Solutions \& Planning Platforms**

*Job Description \| Finance Technology*

**Position Summary**


We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated **Senior Lead, Anaplan Solutions \& Planning Platforms** to lead the implementation, support, and strategic expansion of enterprise planning solutions across Finance. This role will own delivery outcomes across Anaplan Staff Planning, Forecasting, CCAR support, Income Statement planning, Data Hub architecture, integrations, UX reporting, and future planning modernization capabilities.


The ideal candidate is not only a strong Anaplan expert, but also a capability builder who can establish delivery discipline, mentor a team, strengthen governance, and translate business priorities into scalable, controlled, and user\-friendly planning solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**


1\. **Required Technical Skills \& Experience**

* Deep expertise in Anaplan solution architecture, model building, Data Hub design, ALM, UX development, and deployment management, with a proven ability to design scalable, high\-performing enterprise planning solutions.
* Strong functional knowledge of FP\&A, workforce planning, budgeting, forecasting, scenario modeling, and financial data management, with the ability to translate complex business requirements into actionable planning capabilities.
* Experience leading end\-to\-end implementation and enhancement of enterprise planning platforms, including requirements gathering, solution design, development, testing, deployment, governance, and production support.
* Proven ability to design and manage enterprise data integrations, leveraging APIs, SQL, and data analysis techniques to ensure data accuracy, integrity, and timely availability across planning ecosystems.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and troubleshooting skills with expertise in reporting, analytics, controls, access management, documentation, and regulatory compliance requirements.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel and financial modeling, complemented by experience working within Agile delivery frameworks and modern Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) practices.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross\-functional teams, influence stakeholders, establish best practices, and drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance planning efficiency, data quality, and business outcomes.
 **2\.****Leadership \& Team Development**

* Build, mentor, and lead a high\-performing Anaplan delivery team comprising model builders, analysts, engineers, and solution SMEs.
* Establish clear ways of working across backlog management, sprint execution, release planning, quality reviews, documentation, and production support.
* Coach team members on Anaplan best practices, model design, data management, performance optimization, and business engagement.
* Create a sustainable capability model with role clarity, cross\-training, succession planning, and measurable skill maturity.
 **3****. Strategy, Roadmap \& Stakeholder Management**

* Partner with Finance, FP\&A, HR, Risk, Corporate Functions, and Technology stakeholders to define priorities, business outcomes, and delivery roadmap.
* Translate business needs into scalable Anaplan solutions that improve forecasting, workforce planning, scenario analysis, expense planning, and management reporting.
* Act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders by providing clear options, risks, dependencies, trade\-offs, and recommendations.
* Lead prioritization forums and drive alignment across business value, regulatory needs, capacity, and technical feasibility.
 **3\. Solution Architecture \& Delivery Ownership**

* Own end\-to\-end design and delivery of enterprise Anaplan capabilities across Staff Planning, Forecasting, CCAR, Income Statement planning, cost center planning, and scenario modeling.
* Design scalable multi\-model architectures using Data Hub, ALM, controlled data flows, modular design principles, and reusable planning components.
* Ensure models are performant, auditable, maintainable, secure, and aligned to Anaplan and enterprise technology standards.
* Oversee requirements, design, build, testing, UAT, deployment, documentation, and post\-production stabilization.
 **4\. Platform Operations, Controls \& Data Quality**

* Strengthen production support, incident management, release governance, access controls, and operational risk management.
* Establish data validation, reconciliation, completeness checks, and error\-handling processes across inbound and outbound planning data.
* Drive improvements in platform stability, data accuracy, business adoption, user experience, and planning cycle efficiency.
* Maintain strong documentation for model architecture, data lineage, integrations, controls, release records, and support procedures.
 **5\. Innovation \& Continuous Improvement**

* Identify opportunities to simplify planning processes, automate manual activities, enhance reporting visibility, and improve self\-service capability.
* Evaluate and apply modern planning practices including predictive planning, advanced analytics, AI\-enabled insights, and integration automation where appropriate.
* Promote a culture of continuous improvement, operational precision, accountability, and business\-value driven delivery.
 **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems
* 10\+ years of experience in enterprise planning, financial systems, EPM platforms, FP\&A technology, or related finance technology domains.
* 8\+ years of hands\-on Anaplan implementation, model building, and solution architecture experience.
* Proven experience leading enterprise\-scale planning implementations from concept through production deployment.
* Strong working knowledge of FP\&A, forecasting, budgeting, workforce planning, management reporting, cost center planning, and financial data structures.
* Anaplan Certified Solution Architect or Master Anaplanner credentials preferred.
* Experience with Hyperion, Oracle EPM, OneStream, SAP BPC, Workday, Power BI, SQL, ETL tools, APIs, or enterprise data platforms is good to have
* Experience in banking, financial services, regulatory planning, risk, CCAR, SOX\-controlled environments, or large global enterprises.
* Strong Agile delivery experience and familiarity with SDLC, DevOps, change management, and release governance.
* Experience designing Data Hub architecture, integrations, validation routines, and controlled data flows.
* Demonstrated experience building, mentoring, and leading technical teams.
* Excellent executive communication, stakeholder management, analytical thinking, and problem\-solving skills.
 **Working with Us**

  

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.  



  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.  



  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

  

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.  

  



  

**About Our Pune Office**

  

The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.

  

Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000\+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

**Job Description**
**Job Title:** 
 Planisware Architect
   

  

**Location: Pune, India**
**Company Overview**
**About SLB**
 SLB is the world's leading provider of technology for reservoir characterization, drilling, production, and processing to the oil and gas industry. Working in more than 85 countries and employing approximately 100,000 people who represent over 140 nationalities, SLB supplies the industry's most comprehensive range of products and services, from exploration through production and integrated pore\-to\-pipeline solutions for hydrocarbon recovery that optimize reservoir performance. Visit www.slb.com for more information.
   

  

 We are a global technology company driving energy innovation for a balanced planet. Together, we create amazing technology that unlocks access to energy for the benefit of all. Our inclusive culture is the key to our success. We collaborate with our internal community of colleagues, alumni, and our valued external partners to support each other and achieve our goals. We aim to raise the bar high. We look for people who are committed to innovation and success and act with integrity to become and be a part of one of the most diverse group of experts in our industry, anywhere around the globe. Global in outlook, and local in practice, we're united in our passion for discovering solutions and in our commitment to creating a sustainable and balanced future. We set the bar high. So we’re looking for talented, driven people committed to innovation and success and who act with integrity. We'll give you a platform to develop both professionally and personally, supported by our community of colleagues, co\-workers, alumni, and our valued external partners. It's a deep collaboration that enables us all to achieve our goals. Come and be part of one of the world’s most diverse and inclusive groups of industry experts.

 SLB has embarked on a corporate transformation to deliver a step change in the reliability, efficiency and integration of our technologies, products and services. Advanced technologies are key enablers to this and encompass all aspects of business systems, including the organization platform and processes. Investments in, and building strong competences across our technology pillars – IT Central, SAP, Cyber Security, Digital Enterprise Systems, Data and Analytics, Digital Operations, Architecture and Integration, and Governance and Performance are key to an integrated digital that is positioned to deliver superior results. The SLB India Technology Center has a fundamental and critical role in this corporate transformation and for delivering digital solutions to the larger SLB organization.
   

  

**About Role**

Further, he/she will define periodic release plans and release schedules in coordination with the domain teams and the L3 vendor while being supervised by the Chief Scrum Master. He / she would manage the execution of release activities and co\-ordinate with the L3 development teams to ensure releases are delivered on time and within budget.

* Strategic Alignment: Work with product management and IT leadership to align Planisware functionality with business strategies and project goals.

* Customization Framework: Define best practices and frameworks for customizing Planisware to meet the evolving needs of the business.
* Integration Strategy: Develop and implement integration strategies to connect Planisware with other enterprise systems. Optimizing the API calls to minimize the performance issues \& Cost.
* Governance \& Best Practices: Establish governance around Planisware usage, ensuring the platform is optimized for scalability, security, and performance.
* Performance Tuning: Monitor system performance, ensuring efficient use of resources, and troubleshoot issues as they arise.
* Technical Leadership: Provide guidance and mentorship to development teams, ensuring high\-quality deliverables Serve as a SPOC to the L3 inhouse / vendor development team and coordinate all development and testing activities. Help development team to understand the error causes on production environment
* Review and get technical feasibility validation of the technical design provided by L3 for the change requests.
* Ensure adoption of Scrum in the development process. Also ensure DevOps is adopted within the team efficiently
* Work on roll\-back scenarios and identify cases where roll\-backs are necessary

* Proven experience in designing and deploying Planisware for large\-scale organizations, particularly in product or project management. Familiarity with enterprise architecture and software development life cycle (SDLC) methodologies
* Manage risks and resolves issues that affect release scope, schedule and quality
* Ensure technical documentation is kept up to date by the development team
* Proactively identify and implement procedures to streamline the build process which may drive the development and maintenance of an automated build process

**Essential Qualifications**

**Key competencies**

* Experience working on multiple releases/projects as a subject matter expert and as a technical leader. Should have worked on complex projects that require expertise across multiple disciples and environments
* Very good understanding around building Planisware based solution and Integration / data migration processes
* Experience working in an Agile/Scrum/Kanban environment

e482139e.title: Principal Architect - Apps & AI
e482139e.description:
**Overview**
 Microsoft Industry Solutions – Global Center Innovation and Delivery Center (GCID) delivers end\-to\-end solutions by enabling accelerated adoption and productive use of Microsoft technologies. An organization of well over 1000\+ exceptional people, GCID presents a compelling opportunity for senior technical leaders to drive enterprise scale transformation through consulting, architecture, and delivery leadership.
   

  

 The Principal Architect is a senior technical and business leader accountable for shaping, influencing, and driving successful outcomes across large, complex, multiyear enterprise engagements. This role operates at the convergence of technology, business strategy, and executive decision making, acting as a trusted advisor to customer CEO, CIO, CTO, and CDO stakeholders.
   

  

 In the AI first GCID organization, Principal Architects lead the adoption of AI native, cloud first, and platform driven execution models at enterprise scale—ensuring solutions are not only technically sound but strategically aligned with customer business transformation goals.
   

  

 Microsoft Industry Solutions – Global Center Innovation and Delivery Center (GCID) delivers end\-to\-end solutions by enabling accelerated adoption and productive use of Microsoft technologies. An organization of well over 1000\+ exceptional people, GCID presents a compelling opportunity for senior technical leaders to drive enterprise scale transformation through consulting, architecture, and delivery leadership.
   

  

 The Principal Architect is a senior technical and business leader accountable for shaping, influencing, and driving successful outcomes across large, complex, multiyear enterprise engagements. This role operates at the convergence of technology, business strategy, and executive decision making, acting as a trusted advisor to customer CEO, CIO, CTO, and CDO stakeholders.
   

  

 In the AI first GCID organization, Principal Architects lead the adoption of AI native, cloud first, and platform driven execution models at enterprise scale—ensuring solutions are not only technically sound but strategically aligned with customer business transformation goals.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 AI First Enterprise Delivery Leadership
   

  

* Own and drive enterprise scale architecture and delivery execution across highly complex customer portfolios, ensuring alignment to business strategy, transformation goals, and long term technology roadmaps.
* Embed AI first and AI native principles across solution design, delivery models, and operating frameworks—driving intelligent automation, agentic workflows, and data driven execution at scale.
* Serve as the primary executive technical interface for CIO / CTO / CDO leadership, translating business strategy into scalable architecture, delivery plans, and transformation milestones.
* Lead strategic recovery and stabilization of high risk or mission critical programs, establishing executive credibility and clear, outcome driven remediation paths.
* Influence architectural direction beyond a single program—shaping account level, industry level, and GCID wide technical strategies.


 Engineering Excellence
   

  

* Set and enforce engineering excellence standards across organizations, ensuring architecture integrity, quality, security, resilience, and performance at enterprise scale.
* Champion modern engineering practices including AI assisted development, DevSecOps, SRE, observability, and platform engineering.
* Drive creation and reuse of enterprise grade reference architectures, accelerators, patterns, and paved road platforms.
* Establish and govern architecture review cadences aligned with the Microsoft WellArchitected Framework, influencing decisions at executive and transformation program levels.


 Innovation \& Thought Leadership
   

  

* Act as a visible thought leader with customers and internal leadership—shaping future state architectures, modernization strategies, and AI adoption roadmaps.
* Track and evaluate emerging technologies, AI platforms, and engineering paradigms to inform strategic investments and differentiated offerings.
* Influence innovation across GCID by sharing best practices, defining reusable assets, and mentoring senior architects.


 Client Engagement \& Solutioning
   

  

* Operate as a trusted advisor to CEO / CIO / CTO stakeholders, guiding executive level conversations on digital transformation, AI adoption, cloud strategy, platform modernization, and operating model changes.
* Lead executive design sessions, architecture boards, and transformation roadmap reviews, providing clear tradeoff analysis across cost, risk, timetovalue, and strategic outcomes.
* Own technical leadership during presales, deal shaping, and complex pursuits, including estimates, risk profiling, executive narratives, and differentiated solution design.
* Build long term executive relationships that position GCID as a strategic transformation partner, not just a delivery vendor.


 Team Leadership, Mentorship \& Organizational Impact
   

  

* Provide seniormost technical leadership across multiple architect teams, fostering a strong culture of accountability, rigor, and innovation.
* Mentor and develop senior and principal architects, setting clear expectations for L64/L65 progression and impact.
* Influence talent strategy, capability development, and succession planning across Apps \& AI engineering communities.


 Quality, Security \& Compliance
   

  

* Ensure enterprise grade security, governance, reliability, and compliance across all engagements.
* Drive adoption of secure by design, Responsible AI, and privacy first engineering practices aligned with customer regulatory and risk postures.
* Partner with customer security, risk, and compliance leadership to design architectures ready for regulated and highly scrutinized environments.


**Other**
* Embody our culture and values


**Qualifications**
* 22\+ years of experience in software engineering and enterprise architecture, with significant experience operating at CxO level technical leadership roles.
* Proven track record leading largescale transformation programs across cloud, data, AI, and modern application platforms.
* Strong executive communication, stakeholder influence, and decision making capability.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience; advanced certifications and industry recognition preferred.


 Areas of Expertise
   

  

 (All areas below assume enterprise scale ownership and executive level influence)
   

  

 Full Stack Application Engineering
   

  

* End\-to\-end architecture leadership for modern, largescale application ecosystems
* Deep expertise in distributed systems, scalability, performance, and secure application design


 AIDriven \& AIEnabled Application Development
   

  

* Define and govern enterprise AI architectures using Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Services, and agentic systems
* Executive oversight of Responsible AI, governance, observability, and cost optimization strategies


 CloudNative Architecture (Azure)
   

  

* Design and influence platform centric, PaaSfirst enterprise architectures
* Lead cost, resilience, security, and multiregion strategies aligned to business continuity goals


 DevOps, Platform \& Developer Productivity
   

  

* Shape enterprise DevOps, platform engineering, and developer productivity strategies
* Drive standardization of CI/CD, IaC, security automation, and pavedroad platforms


 Solutioning, PreSales \& Strategic Leadership
   

  

* Own technical strategy for large, complex, highvalue deals
* Translate executive business priorities into competitive, differentiated architectures
* Influence both customer and internal leadership on technical investment and risk decisions


 Frontier Engineering \& Customer Enablement Skills
   

  

* Lead earlystage innovation, pilots, and lighthouse programs with executive sponsorship
* Guide customers from whiteboard concepts to scaled production platforms
* Operate confidently in ambiguous, highpressure executive environments, balancing speed with governance


 Personal Attributes
   

  

* Executive presence with the ability to influence CEO / CIO / CTO stakeholders
* Strong strategic thinking combined with deep technical credibility
* Outcome oriented mindset with a focus on measurable business impact
* Passion for technology, leadership, and continuous growth


 This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

8b5791d0.title: Cloud Security Architect
8b5791d0.description:
**About Cognizant**
 Cognizant is a global community united by a shared purpose: to make a meaningful impact. We are committed to excellence and driven by outcomes that matter. Collaboration is at the heart of how we work, and our forward\-thinking mindset fuels continuous learning, innovation, and growth.
   

  

 At Cognizant, careers transcend titles. We empower our people to think strategically, inspire others, and lead with purpose, always guided by our core values. Join us in shaping the future of business. Could you be the one to make a difference?
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a
 **Cloud Security Architect** 
 , you will lead the design, validation, and governance of security architecture across enterprise cloud and hybrid environments. You will play a critical role in ensuring cloud\-native and hybrid architectures align with Cognizant’s security reference architecture, regulatory obligations, and business objectives across multi\-cloud platforms including Microsoft Azure, AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).
   

  

 You will work independently with senior stakeholders, enterprise architects, security teams, cloud engineering teams, DevSecOps practitioners, and compliance leaders to provide end\-to\-end ownership of cloud security architecture from threat modeling and design reviews through implementation validation and operational governance. You will have the opportunity to influence strategic cloud adoption initiatives, modern security architectures, and enterprise\-wide cloud governance programs while mentoring teams and driving security excellence.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Govern the security architecture of enterprise cloud and hybrid environments across Azure, AWS, GCP, and OCI platforms.
* Conduct cloud security architecture reviews covering Identity and Access Management (IAM), Privileged Identity Management (PIM), network segmentation, micro\-segmentation, and Zero Trust security models.
* Partner with Cloud Management Office, enterprise architecture, security, and engineering teams to integrate security requirements into cloud design and architecture decisions.
* Define and implement cloud security standards, architectural patterns, governance controls, and security guardrails.
* Embed security requirements into Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD pipelines, and cloud automation frameworks.
* Collaborate with compliance and risk stakeholders to ensure cloud solutions meet regulatory and security requirements.
* Evaluate emerging cloud services, container platforms, serverless technologies, and AI\-enabled solutions while providing architectural guidance and security recommendations.
* Serve as the primary security architecture liaison between enterprise architecture, security governance, control validation, IT security, and business stakeholders.
* Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) and service level objectives (SLOs) for cloud architecture initiatives.
* Lead architecture governance reviews, risk assessments, threat modeling exercises, and solution validation activities.
* Mentor security, architecture, cloud, and engineering teams on secure cloud operations and cloud security best practices.
* Stay current on cloud provider roadmaps, threat landscape developments, regulatory requirements, and industry security standards.


**What You Must Have To Be Considered**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
* 10\+ years of experience in information security and cybersecurity architecture.
* 8\+ years of experience securing enterprise cloud environments across Azure, AWS, GCP, and/or OCI.
* Proven experience designing and governing cloud security architectures for large\-scale enterprise deployments.
* Demonstrated experience leading cloud architecture security reviews and evaluating security controls against cloud frameworks and assurance programs.
* Experience implementing and governing cloud security requirements within DevSecOps environments.
* Strong expertise in cloud security architecture, threat modeling, risk management, and security governance.
* Experience working with enterprise architecture, compliance, risk, audit, and operational stakeholders.
* Experience managing, mentoring, and guiding architecture, engineering, or validation teams.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and strategic planning skills.
* A strong sense of ownership, desire to create meaningful outcomes, and passion for improving the security posture of cloud environments.
* The embodiment of Cognizant’s Values of: Work as One, Dare to Innovate, Raise the Bar, Do the Right Thing, and Own It.


**These Will Help You Succeed**
* Deep expertise in Microsoft Azure, including Landing Zones, Azure Policy, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Palo Alto Cortex, API Security, DSPM, Zscaler and Microsoft Entra ID.
* Working knowledge of AWS and Google Cloud Platform security services and governance frameworks.
* Experience with container platforms including AKS, EKS, and GKE.
* Knowledge of Kubernetes security, RBAC, network policies, and service mesh technologies.
* Strong cloud networking expertise including VNet/VPC design, hub\-and\-spoke architectures, ExpressRoute, Direct Connect, firewall controls, and micro\-segmentation.
* Expertise in Zero Trust Architecture, IAM, PIM, Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM), and SIEM/SOAR integrations.
* Experience with security and compliance frameworks including PCI DSS, HIPAA, ISO 27001, NIST CSF 2\.0, NIST SP 800\-53, and Cyber Essentials Plus.
* Experience using Terraform, Bicep, ARM Templates, CloudFormation, GitOps, and CI/CD security controls.
* Proficiency in PowerShell, Python, Bash, and cloud automation practices.
* Strong analytical and structured problem\-solving abilities.
* Proven ability to communicate complex technical concepts to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Strong cross\-functional collaboration and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Leadership experience coaching and mentoring architects, engineers, and security practitioners.


**Preferred Certifications**
* Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP).
* Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP) or Certificate of Cloud Security Knowledge (CCSK).
* Microsoft Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ\-500\) or equivalent AWS Certified Security – Specialty or GCP Professional Cloud Security Engineer certification.
* Microsoft Cybersecurity Architect Expert (SC\-100\).
* Microsoft Identity and Access Administrator Associate (SC\-300\).
* Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ\-305\) or equivalent AWS or GCP Professional Architect certification.
* Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA).


**Work Model**
 We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring attendance at a client or Cognizant office as determined by business needs. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work\-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.

97ffa6b3.title: Pre-Sales Consultant
97ffa6b3.description:
**SURYA AT A GLANCE** 
 Surya creates software products and provides implementation services for financial risk management of banks and the financial services industry. We provide web\-based, shared facility treasury management products for corporates. Founded in 1999, Surya’s client base is spread across four continents. We help more than 75\+ banks, hedge funds, and corporations around the world make better business decisions by mitigating risk, enhancing profitability, and complying with regulatory requirements. We are headquartered in Bangalore, India. We also have offices in Dubai, UK, USA and France.
   

  

* Designation: Pre\-Sales Consultant
* Relevant Experience: 2 \- 4 Years
* Qualification: MBA (Finance/Banking), CA, CFA, FRM, B.Com, M.Com, BBM, BE/B.Tech or equivalent qualification


**Roles And Responsibilities**
 As a Pre\-Sales Consultant, you will support business development and sales engagements by understanding client requirements, positioning Surya’s solutions, and demonstrating the value of our products to banks, financial institutions, and corporate customers. The role requires close collaboration with Sales, Product, and Delivery teams across the complete sales lifecycle.
   

  

* Attend client requirement discussions and understand business, functional, and solution needs.
* Conduct product demonstrations, solution walkthroughs, workshops, and presentations for prospective customers.
* Prepare and submit responses for RFPs, RFIs, RFQs, and other proposal\-related documentation.
* Prepare solution decks, product write\-ups, proposal content, business presentations, and customer\-facing collateral.
* Provide content support for certifications, ratings, analyst questionnaires, industry assessments, and related submissions.
* Work collaboratively with Field Sales, Sales Operations, Inside Sales, Product, and Delivery teams to support sales opportunities.
* Assist in solution positioning, proposal preparation, proof\-of\-concept discussions, and customer clarifications.
* Stay updated on banking, financial risk management, regulatory developments, and competitive product offerings.
* Travel to customer locations for meetings, demonstrations, workshops, and business development activities as required


**Required Skills**
*Functional*
* Good understanding of banking and financial services industry.
* Ability to understand customer requirements and map them to product capabilities.
* Exposure to Treasury, ALM, Liquidity Risk, Market Risk, IRRBB, FTP, Basel II/III, Stress Testing, or related risk management areas is desirable.
* Ability to prepare customer\-facing solution proposals, presentations, and business write\-ups.


*Technical*
* Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, and Word – Mandatory.
* Ability to create clear solution decks, product collateral, and proposal documents.
* SQL basics and understanding of databases – Good to have.
* Understanding of enterprise software products and implementation lifecycle is an added advantage.

d826a163.title: Senior Solution Architect — Sales AI Applications
d826a163.description:
NVIDIA pioneers computer graphics, gaming, AI, and accelerated computing. We are looking for a Senior Solution Architect with full\-stack software engineering experience to join our team and play an important role in developing Sales AI applications. This position offers the opportunity to design, build, and evolve solutions that bring generative AI and intelligent workflows into everyday sales experiences.
   

  

 You will work across the application stack and collaborate with Product, AI and machine learning, Data, Security, Solution Architecture, and Engineering teams to deliver secure, reliable, and scalable solutions used globally.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
* Collaborate with application teams to design, develop, and maintain scalable full\-stack solutions for enterprise sales workflows.
* Guide technical solutions across front\-end, back\-end, APIs, data services, integrations, and cloud infrastructure.
* Translate product requirements and business needs into secure, maintainable solutions and intuitive user experiences.
* Integrate generative AI models, AI services, APIs, retrieval systems, and agentic workflows into production applications.
* Design application architectures that support performance, availability, observability, security, scalability, and long\-term maintainability.
* Lead technical design discussions, compare implementation approaches, make informed architecture decisions, and evaluate emerging technologies.
* Improve engineering practices for testing, code quality, continuous integration and delivery, monitoring, documentation, and production readiness. Investigate complex issues and develop solutions that improve reliability and user experience.
* Mentor engineers, share technical knowledge, and contribute to engineering standards and collaborative team practices.


**What We Need To See**
* A bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field is encouraged.
* 10\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including building and operating production applications.
* Experience developing full\-stack applications with modern front\-end, back\-end, and web application technologies.
* Proficiency in one or more languages or frameworks, such as Python, Java, JavaScript, React, Node.js, or similar technologies.
* Experience designing APIs, distributed applications, data services, enterprise integrations, scalable cloud applications, databases, and messaging systems.
* Experience integrating AI or machine learning capabilities through APIs, models, retrieval systems, or AI services.
* Knowledge of software architecture, system design, security, testing, observability, and production operations.
* Ability to lead technical initiatives, make informed engineering decisions, communicate with technical and non\-technical teams, and mentor engineers.


**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* Experience building generative AI applications, including AI assistants, retrieval\-augmented generation, agentic workflows, AI productivity tools, Python\-based AI services, large language model APIs, vector databases, prompt engineering, or AI evaluation.
* Experience combining traditional software systems with AI models and data pipelines and progressing AI capabilities from prototype through production.
* Familiarity with responsible AI, data privacy, access controls, security, or enterprise AI governance.
* Experience with Kubernetes, containers, microservices, infrastructure as code, DevOps practices, application performance, reliability, scalability, observability, cloud cost efficiency, or globally distributed engineering teams.


 NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward\-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you’re creative, eager to tackle meaningful business problems, and enjoy having fun, NVIDIA is the perfect company to work for.

d44ed492.description:
**Description**
**Salesforce Solution Architect / Senior Salesforce Solution Architect**
**Key Responsibilities**
 As an Industry Success Architect, you will specialize in multiple Industry Clouds with primary, secondary, and tertiary areas of expertise. You will:
   

  

* Drive Customer Impact \- Partner with our most strategic and high\-priority customers, assessing their Industry Cloud implementations and delivering expert recommendations on technical architecture, solution design, application lifecycle management, reliability, and feature adoption.
* Lifesciences Expertise \- Serve as a trusted Subject Matter Expert (SME) in your Lifesciences Industry Clouds, providing both proactive and reactive guidance on architecture, technology strategy, thought leadership, and product best practices.
* Communicate with Clarity \- Simplify complex technical concepts for diverse audiences, from technical teams to executive leadership, positioning yourself as a trusted advisor in key business and technology discussions.
* Innovate \& Solve Problems \- Identify capability gaps and design inefficiencies, recommending product enhancements or creative custom solutions that drive customer success and long\-term adoption.
* Execute Proven Strategies \- Leverage and tailor Success Architect playbooks to meet the unique challenges and opportunities of your Industry Cloud customers.
* Build Strong Relationships \- Collaborate with internal and external partners, fostering connections that drive customer success, product improvement, and overall business growth.


**Basic Requirements**
* Solution Design \& Architecture
* 10\+ years of experience in developing technology solutions.
* 5\+ years of experience in software, system, or enterprise architecture with experience in Lifesciences domain.
* Expertise in Salesforce products, platform capabilities, technical governance, and best practices.
* Experience with large\-scale, complex implementations, including SaaS, PaaS, multi\-tenancy, and multi\-tiered infrastructure.
* Strong knowledge of enterprise application integration, covering process orchestration, master data management, AI, analytics, and security best practices.
* Communication \& Leadership
* Ability to assess business objectives, propose solution options, and drive stakeholder alignment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex technical concepts to both business and executive audiences.
* Skilled in creating clear, visually compelling design documents for diverse stakeholders.
* Proven ability to lead discussions, influence decision\-making, and advocate for best practices.
* Strategic Thinking \& Problem Solving
* Ability to identify design inefficiencies, recommend optimizations, and drive customer transformation.
* Provide data\-driven insights on customer success stories and industry trends.
* Passion for continuous learning and staying ahead of emerging technologies.


**Desired Technical Skills**
* Secure \& Scalable Architecture: Expertise in role hierarchy, sharing rules, profiles, permission sets, and security configurations. Proven ability to design scalable, high\-performance architectures aligned with Salesforce best practices, including Large Data Volume (LDV) considerations.
* Salesforce Development: Hands\-on experience with APEX programming, JavaScript, Visualforce, and Lightning Web Components (LWC). Familiarity with governor limits and best practices for efficient code execution.
* Data Management \& Integration: Proficient in designing and managing data models, validation rules, and data governance best practices. Experience with data import/export, ETL tools, and integrating Salesforce with external systems via REST/SOAP APIs and middleware (e.g., MuleSoft).
* System Integration \& Extensibility: Strong understanding of integrating Salesforce with other enterprise systems using APIs, middleware, and event\-driven architectures. Experience working with OAuth, Platform Events, External Objects, and tools like Salesforce Connect.
* OmniStudio Knowledge: Experience with OmniStudio components is required.
* DevOps (Core \+ Industry): Strong understanding of software development and delivery process, assessing architecture environments and requirements in order to implement management solutions.


**Certifications**
* Required: Salesforce Admin, Platform Developer 1 and JavaScript Developer
* Highly Desired: Certified Architect Credentials (Application and System Architect), Platform App Builder, Salesforce Advanced Admin and an Accredited Professional credential in at least one Industry Cloud specialization (e.g., Financial Services Cloud, Health Cloud, or Public Sector Solutions).

* Provide day\-to\-day technical direction, guidance, and mentorship to developers and engineers.

* Review code and implementation approaches to ensure alignment with the agreed architecture and technical standards.
* Identify and proactively manage technical risks, dependencies, architectural gaps, and performance concerns.
* Collaborate with client stakeholders, product teams, engineering teams, and other technology groups.
* Ensure architecture principles, technical standards, security requirements, and design decisions are consistently followed.
* Support technical design reviews, troubleshooting, production issues, and technical problem resolution.
* Maintain a comprehensive understanding of the solution and ensure technical continuity across the project.
* Mentor technical team members and help strengthen the team's architecture and engineering capabilities.


**Primary Skills**
* 15\+ years of overall IT experience, with significant experience in Solution Architecture / Technical Architecture roles.
* Strong experience in enterprise solution architecture and system design.
* Extensive experience with microservices, distributed systems, and modern application architectures.
* Strong knowledge of API design, REST APIs, integration patterns, and enterprise integrations.
* Strong experience designing and implementing solutions on AWS, Azure, and/or GCP.
* Strong understanding of modern architecture patterns, principles, and best practices.
* Strong hands\-on experience with AI, Generative AI, LLM\-based applications, and Agentic AI.

* Understanding of integrating AI/ML capabilities with enterprise applications, APIs, data platforms, and cloud services.
* Experience with databases, data integration, messaging, and enterprise application architecture.
* Strong understanding of security, scalability, availability, performance, resiliency, and observability.
* Experience with CI/CD, DevOps practices, and modern software engineering methodologies.
* Ability to assess existing architectures and recommend practical improvements.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills.

* The candidate should possess excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder\-management skills and be comfortable working with both technical and business stakeholders.

* Make and defend architecture and technology decisions.
* Lead architecture and technical discussions with customers and internal stakeholders.
* Guide developers and engineers through complex technical challenges.

This position is considered remote which means it does not require job duties be performed within proximity of a CohnReznick office location. However, as a remote employee, you may be required to be present at a CohnReznick office with scheduled notice for client work, team meetings, or trainings.
   

  

**YOUR TEAM.**
 This position will support our GDC team and this SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud Administrator is responsible for the comprehensive management, maintenance, and optimization of SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud systems. This role involves ensuring system performance, reliability, and security while supporting business operations and strategic initiatives.
   

  

**WHY COHNREZNICK?**
 At CohnReznick, we’re united by a common mission to create opportunity, value, and trust for our clients, our people, and our communities. Whether it’s working alongside your peers to solve a client challenge, or volunteering together at the local food bank, there are so many ways to find your “why” at the firm.
   

  

 We believe it’s important to balance work with everyday life – and make time for enjoyment and fun. We invest in a robust Total Rewards package that includes everything from generous PTO, a flexible work environment, expanded parental leave, extensive learning \& development, and even paid time off for employees to volunteer.
   

  

**YOUR ROLE.**
**Responsibilities Include But Not Limited To**
* Configure and maintain financial applications within SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud to ensure optimal performance and reliability.
* OTC Process Management
* Architect, configure, and maintain SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud OTC processes, ensuring end\-to\-end order lifecycle from order entry to invoicing and cash application.


* Integration
+ Integrate OTC with other SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud modules (FICO, Project Systems) and external systems using SAP Cloud Platform Integration (CPI), APIs, and EDI/IDoc interfaces.

* System Optimization
+ Monitor OTC transaction flows, troubleshoot issues, and optimize performance.
+ Oversee upgrades, UAT, and change management for OTC and cross\-functional projects.

* Support \& Training
+ Provide advanced support and training to OTC users, ensuring adoption and satisfaction.

* Continuous Improvement
+ Drive automation and process improvements leveraging SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud Fiori apps and analytics.
+ Monitor system performance and proactively identify and resolve issues.
+ Manage user access and security policies to safeguard system integrity.
+ Document system configurations and procedures for future reference and compliance.
+ Provide user support and training to ensure effective system utilization.
+ Lead system audits and compliance checks to meet regulatory requirements.
+ Implement new SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud ecosystem modules and features to enhance system capabilities.
+ Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to integrate SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud systems with other business applications.
+ Develop and execute system improvement plans to optimize performance and efficiency.
+ Monitor all upcoming changes being deployed by SAP. Work on testing plans and keeping senior staff updated on upcoming changes.
+ Understand downstream impacts of changes including hot fixes. Create impact summary and review with leadership.
+ Execute UAT and tasks for Upgrades, Mergers and Acquisitions, Vendor Coordination, and other associated projects.
+ Monitor and troubleshoot SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud ecosystem integrations.
+ Serve as backup to other team members to backfill during peak periods, PTO, etc.

**Outcomes**+ Efficiently manage and optimize SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud systems to support business operations.
+ Ensure high system performance and reliability to meet user needs.
+ Implement/Maintain robust user access and security policies to protect system data.
+ Resolve complex system issues promptly to minimize downtime.
+ Maintain comprehensive system documentation for future reference.
+ Provide advanced user support and training to enhance system utilization.
+ Lead successful system audits and compliance checks to meet regulatory requirements.
+ Implement new SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud features and modules to enhance system capabilities.
+ Collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams to integrate SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud systems with other business applications.

**Your Experience.**
**The successful candidate will have:**+ At least 3 to 5 years’ experience with SAP S/4 Hana Public Cloud with a focus on financial accounting or professional service organizations.
+ Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field to ensure foundational knowledge.
+ Excellent communication and teamwork abilities to collaborate with various stakeholders. Experience working in a global team environment.
+ In\-depth knowledge of data management to ensure data integrity.
+ SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud certification to validate expertise.
+ Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously to meet business demands.
+ Lead meetings by setting clear objectives, driving focused and collaborative discussion, and ensuring accountability for timely completion of action items.

**Required Knowledge And Skills**+ Comprehensive knowledge of SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud architecture to understand system components.
+ SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud Expertise
+ Deep knowledge of SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud OTC functionalities and SD module.
+ Familiarity with SAP Activate methodology, cloud implementation lifecycle, and best practices.


* Technical Skills
+ Experience with Fiori apps, workflow management, and user roles.
+ Proficiency in data migration tools (e.g., migration cockpit) and integration technologies.

* Business Process Knowledge
+ Strong understanding of Quote\-to\-Cash processes, pricing procedures, credit management, returns, and revenue recognition.

* Working knowledge and subject matter expertise in one or more SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud functional areas, including FICO, Order\-to\-Cash (OTC), Project Systems (PS), Security, and/or system integrations. Proficiency in system monitoring and performance tuning to maintain optimal operation.
* Advanced scripting skills (e.g., Bash, PowerShell) to automate tasks. (preferred)
* Strong understanding of user access and security management to protect system integrity.
* Advanced troubleshooting skills to resolve complex issues. This includes what is an incident versus what is a defect.
* Expertise in data management systems (e.g., S4 Hana Public Cloud transport management) to manage data effectively.
* Knowledge of project management methodologies to lead system improvement initiatives i.e., SAP Activate.


**Technologies, Coding Languages, And Methodologies**
* SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud for enterprise resource planning.
* SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud Fiori for user interface and experience.
* SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud GUI for system access and management.
* Windows and Microsoft Office Suite operating systems for diverse environments. Cloud computing platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure) for scalable infrastructure.
