* Please note that this role may require you to work in rotational shifts

ec3b25e5.title: Engineering & Delivery Lead - Data Services
ec3b25e5.description:
We are seeking a highly accomplished, hands\-on
 **SVP – Engineering \& Delivery Lead (Data Services)** 
 to join our technology leadership team in Pune. In this critical engineering role, you will serve as the
 **Platform Tech Lead** 
 and take end\-to\-end ownership of the technical delivery,
 **architectural alignment** 
 , and global engineering execution for our strategic Data Services platforms.
   

  

 This is a senior software engineering leadership and technical delivery role designed for a seasoned software/data engineer with a proven track record of managing engineering teams and technically steering agile workstreams. In this role, you will hold
 **direct line management responsibility** 
 for distributed agile engineering pods, providing people leadership, talent development, and technical oversight.
   

  

 You will be responsible for driving the technical execution of key initiatives, including modernizing our core data services, scaling our data lakehouse infrastructure, and engineering critical regulatory\-driven technology programs, compliance commitments, and enterprise technology mandates. You will own team capacity planning, hiring, talent development, and performance evaluations.
   

  

 A core expectation of this role is an
 **AI\-First Thinking Mindset** 
 . You will actively champion and drive the adoption of generative AI tools (such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, and other developer productivity assistants) to significantly accelerate software delivery, automate testing, and improve code quality across your teams, adapting seamlessly to the enterprise\-approved tools available within our network. You will ensure that all engineering deliverables strictly align with our target architecture, enforce rigorous code and design standards, and maintain hands\-on technical oversight and architectural alignment across multiple global agile engineering workstreams.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Engineering Leadership \& People Management
* Engineering Line Management: Manage, hire, develop, and conduct performance evaluations for a distributed, multi\-location team of software and data engineers, ensuring continuous talent growth and high team engagement.
* Agile Pod Delivery: Provide hands\-on technical leadership and functional management across agile engineering pods, driving daily sprint execution, code reviews, and architectural alignment.
* AI\-First Software Delivery: Champion and drive an AI\-first developer culture. Promote the adoption of generative AI coding assistants and modern productivity tools to accelerate software development, automate unit test generation, and streamline code refactoring across your engineering teams.
* End\-to\-End Technical Delivery: Take full accountability for the technical delivery of data services, real\-time pipelines, and platform integrations from inception to production deployment.
* Engineering Excellence: Foster a culture of high\-quality software engineering, enforcing rigorous unit testing, automated integration testing, and continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) practices.
* Architectural Alignment \& Technical Governance
* Architectural Adherence: Ensure all engineering deliverables and system designs strictly align with the target enterprise architecture, design patterns, and future\-state roadmaps defined by the Enterprise Architecture teams.
* Technical Design \& Review: Lead the technical implementation design of platform components, APIs, and data access patterns, ensuring they are optimized for high performance, low latency, and scalability.
* Technical Debt Management: Proactively identify and remediate technical debt, ensuring the platform remains maintainable, resilient, and sustainable.
* Security \& Governance by Design: Enforce strict data security, row/column\-level masking, and access control policies (e.g., Apache Ranger) within all engineered solutions.
* Database Security Compliance: Ensure that all data storage and pipeline implementations adhere to rigorous enterprise security standards, including Transparent Data Encryption (TDE), secure connection protocols, and continuous database auditing.
* Platform Modernization \& API Engineering
* Data Pipeline Engineering: Oversee the engineering of robust, high\-throughput data pipelines across hybrid relational databases and modern cloud\-native lakehouses.
* API \& Microservices Development: Lead the development of standardized, secure, and resilient microservices (primarily Java/Spring Boot) to support high\-concurrency data consumption and AI\-driven use cases.
* Regulatory \& Mandatory Engineering Commitments
* Regulatory Engineering: Lead the technical execution of critical regulatory\-driven technology programs, compliance commitments, and enterprise technology mandates, ensuring engineered solutions are robust, compliant, and delivered within strict timelines.
* Audit\-Ready Standards: Ensure all technical documentation, system designs, and deployment pipelines meet rigorous internal audit and regulatory compliance standards.


 Technology Skills \& Competencies
   

  

**Required Technical Skillsets (Must Be Hands\-on)**
* Java Software Engineering (Core Competence): Advanced, hands\-on expertise in Java and enterprise Java frameworks (specifically Spring Boot, Spring Framework, Hibernate/JPA). Proven track record of developing high\-throughput, low\-latency, and highly secure backend microservices, custom data connectors, and distributed processing modules.
* Database \& NoSQL Engineering (Must\-Have): Deep, hands\-on experience designing, developing, and tuning enterprise\-scale relational databases (Oracle and SQL Server) and document\-based NoSQL stores (MongoDB). Strong proficiency in writing and optimizing complex queries (advanced SQL), managing indexing strategies, and designing high\-availability, clustered, and replicated database architectures (e.g., replica sets, multi\-node clustering).
* AI\-First Developer Skills (Must\-Have): Proven capability and hands\-on experience using generative AI tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent) to accelerate software delivery, write code, generate tests, and optimize development workflows.
* API \& Integration Engineering: Proven experience designing and building secure, high\-performance REST/gRPC APIs, message queues (specifically Apache Kafka or TIBCO EMS), and secure data access patterns.
* CI/CD \& DevOps (Must\-Have): Hands\-on experience building, configuring, and maintaining deployment pipelines in Linux environments. Strong expertise with enterprise CI/CD platforms (specifically Harness or Jenkins), containerization/orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, and RedHat OpenShift), and enterprise workload automation/job scheduling (Autosys).


**Preferred / Nice\-to\-Have Skillsets**
* Data Virtualization \& Federation: Technical and architectural understanding of query federation engines and data virtualization platforms, such as Starburst, Trino, Presto, Denodo, Dremio, AWS Athena, or Apache Drill.
* Agentic AI \& LLM Engineering: Conceptual or hands\-on experience with Agentic AI frameworks and libraries (such as LangChain, LangGraph, Google ADK, or equivalent) for building autonomous AI agents, prompt engineering, and Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines.
* Distributed Data Processing: Familiarity or hands\-on experience with distributed compute engines, specifically Apache Spark (PySpark, Spark SQL) or Apache Flink.
* Modern Lakehouse Platforms: Experience working with cloud\-native enterprise data lakehouse or warehouse platforms (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake, or equivalent).
* Data Quality Automation: Familiarity with automated data quality frameworks (e.g., Great Expectations, dbt, Soda, or Deequ).
* Programming Languages: Familiarity with Python or Scala for auxiliary data manipulation, scripting, or data science integrations.


 Leadership \& Methodology
   

  

* Agile Engineering Delivery: Strong experience running engineering delivery within Scrum/Kanban frameworks, managing sprint closures, and leveraging enterprise tracking tools (specifically Jira and Confluence) to drive visibility and alignment.
* Talent Management (Must\-Have): Proven experience managing hiring, professional development, and performance reviews for technical teams across distributed or international offices.
* Test Strategy Design: Proven track record of designing multi\-layered testing strategies (unit, integration, regression, system, and regression parallel runs for migrations).


**Experience \& Qualifications**
* Total Engineering Experience: Minimum 12\-15\+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, data engineering, or platform development within a large\-scale, highly regulated environment (preferably financial services).
* Technical Leadership \& Line Management: Minimum 5\+ years of direct experience as an engineering line manager, principal engineer, or platform lead with direct people management responsibilities over software/data engineering teams, including experience leading teams across distributed or multi\-location hubs.
* Agile Delivery: Proven track record of driving technical delivery within Scrum/Kanban frameworks, managing sprint commitments, and collaborating closely with product owners.
* Location Requirement: Based in or willing to relocate to Pune, India (hiring hub), with a proven capability of collaborating with, influencing, and aligning global engineering teams across multiple time zones
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related engineering field.

903fd586.title: Solutions Engineer
903fd586.description:
**Meet the Team**
 Join our dynamic Solutions Engineer team at Cisco, where you’ll collaborate with experienced professionals passionate about driving technical sales excellence and enhancing customer engagement. Together, we innovate and deliver cutting\-edge solutions that empower our customers and partners to achieve their business goals. Be part of a supportive environment that fosters growth, teamwork, and meaningful contributions to Cisco’s success.
   

  

**Your Impact**
 As a Technical Sales Professional, you will own the Cisco brand with customers and partners by delivering technical solutions that address their business needs. You will collaborate closely with the account team and connected sales teams to ensure customer success, serving as a trusted technical advisor.
   

  

* Leverage deep knowledge of Cisco’s portfolio, including specialized and architectural perspectives. Drive penetration through cross\-selling and up\-selling while displacing competition. Be responsible for the technical relationship with customers and partners.
* Lead engagements with IT and business decision\-makers, understand customer environments and market dynamics, and translate business needs into technical requirements.
* Focus on landing opportunities and expanding within accounts. Participate actively in customer strategic planning.
* Provide valuable feedback to Business Executives and sales teams on strategic customer needs, market opportunities, and competitive tactics.
* Lead deals through the technical sales process, design and present solutions based on customer requirements, manage virtual sales support teams, and leverage tools to support deals.
* Increase revenue by converting opportunities to closed deals, displace competitors to grow market share, and expand the customer base quarterly.


**What You'll Do**
* Develop multi\-year strategic plans integrating Cisco’s portfolio for customers.
* Deepen expertise by combining domain knowledge with cross\-architectural solutions.
* Shape technical strategies for senior executives.
* Align customer business objectives with industry knowledge to create comprehensive solutions.
* Lead demand generation and enablement initiatives.
* Identify latent customer needs and showcase cross\-architecture solutions.
* Lead impactful demonstrations emphasizing business outcomes driven by Cisco solutions.
* Use competitive intelligence to differentiate Cisco offerings.
* Mobilize broad stakeholder networks to drive transformative synergies and optimize relationships.
* Direct virtual and extended sales teams toward continuous improvement and oversee educational programs.
* Demonstrate agility by adapting strategies in response to market disruptions.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree with 8\+ years of related experience, or an advanced degree (Master's or PhD) with related experience.
* Proficiency in Cisco networking technologies and solutions, including SD\-WAN, MPLS, LAN, Cloud, Unified Communications (UC), and Security.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Strong understanding of cloud computing platforms and services.
* Expertise in Cisco’s cloud portfolio to design scalable, secure, and cost\-effective architectures.
* Hands\-on experience with network automation tools to streamline deployment, management, and operational efficiency of network and collaboration solutions.


 Why Cisco?
   

  

 At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
   

  

 Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
   

  

 We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

 Experience: 3\-8 years
 



 Location: Chennai
 



 Mandatory: SDWAN Overlay/Underlay, Hybrid WAN, Internet/MPLS mix)
 



  





**Strong Knowledge in Solution Design \& Architecture** 



* Design end\-to\-end SD\-WAN solutions (Overlay/Underlay, Hybrid WAN, Internet/MPLS mix)
* Architect secure connectivity solutions integrating SD\-WAN with SASE, Firewall, ZTNA
* Perform network assessments and propose optimized WAN transformation strategies



**Key Responsibilities:** 




 Partner with sales teams in customer meetings, RFPs/RFIs, and technical discussions
 



 Deliver solution presentations, demos, and POCs
 



 Translate business requirements into technical solutions
 



 Identify Global / Local vendor partners to build SD\-WAN product capabilities aligning with functional attributes
 



 Will be completely in charge of procurement (pre/ post testing )product capabilities and functionalities
 



 Build proof of concept (POC) to demonstrate platform capabilities and provide necessary assistance to prospects during product evaluation.
 



 Be the go\-to product expert for the sales team, providing guidance and assistance as needed.
 



 Build and maintain relationships with prospects and become their technical advocate.
 



 Stay up\-to\-date with the latest developments in competitor landscape and provide insights and recommendations to prospects and team members
 



 Influence product roadmap by gathering the critical feedback from prospects and turn them into product requests.
 



 Own product vision, multi year roadmap, and investment planning
 



 Translate regulatory updates, business priorities, and operational insights into product strategy
 



 Lead and mentor Product Managers; drive execution consistency and team development
 



 Champion chart retrieval workflows and user needs across India delivery sites
 



 Partner with Development ,engineering, design, analytics, and operations for integrated delivery
 



 Ensure transparent communication, dependency management, and expectation\-setting
 



 Influence decisions using product metrics and operational data
 



 5\+ years of experience in product management or a closely related role in a SaaS or enterprise software environment.
 



 Proven track record of launching customer\-facing features that drive adoption, usage, and satisfaction.
 



 Strong technical understanding of APIs, integrations, and identity protocols (e.g., SSO, SAML).
 



 Ability to gather and synthesize customer input and translate it into well\-scoped, high\-impact product work.
 



 Experience collaborating with cross\-functional teams and managing roadmaps across multiple releases.
 



**Technical Skills :** 




 Must be familiar with \- VLAN / VTP / STP / VSS / VDC / VPC.
 



 Must have sound knowledge in stack configuration / trouble shooting.
 



 Must be familiar with \- OSPF / EIGRP / BGP / PBR / HSRP / ACL.
 



 Hands on experience with IOS/SUP upgradation 5K/7K/9K/4500/6500/ASR/FTD/FMC/SDWAN/ISE/DNAC/Wireless controller.
 



 Should have knowledge about SDWAN, ISE/ DNAC/ ACI/Wireless
 



 Troubleshooting of complex LAN/WAN infrastructure, Conducting root cause analysis on Network Incident
 



 Troubleshooting IP link related issues like link failure, config mismatch, latency, packet drops.
 



 Expertise in implementing L2 / L3 tunnelling technologies including VLAN’s, VTP, STP, RSTP, MSTP.
 



 Good knowledge of IP Addressing, Subnetting, ARP, OSI and TCP/IP models.
 



 Expertise in implementing routing protocols RIP, EIGRP, OSPF, ISIS and BGP.
 



 Configuring and Troubleshooting Route Redistribution between Static, RIP, EIGRP, OSPF BGP protocols.
 



 Experience in Configuration and Support of LAN protocols on Cisco Switches such as (Layer2, 3 Multi\-Layer).
 



 Experience with designing, deploying, and troubleshooting LAN, WAN, Ether\-channel, IP Routing Protocols \- (RIP, OSPF, EIGRP BGP), ACLs, NAT, VLAN, STP, VTP, HSRP.
 



**Academic Qualifications and Certifications:** 




 Bachelors degree or equivalent qualification in IT/Computing (or demonstrated equivalent work experience).

aaeaf695.title: Project solution Engineer
aaeaf695.description:
**Company Description** 
 Cognex Corporation has been a leader in advanced machine vision for over 40 years, helping manufacturing and distribution organizations automate processes to become faster, smarter, and more efficient. Its innovative vision sensors and systems address critical challenges across industries including automotive, consumer electronics, and packaged goods, delivering high performance and reliability. Cognex leverages AI to make its tools highly capable yet easier to deploy, enabling factories and warehouses to improve quality and productivity without requiring deep technical expertise. The company is headquartered near Boston, USA, operates in more than 30 countries, and serves over 30,000 customers worldwide.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Project Solution Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, and supporting machine vision solutions that meet customer requirements and align with Cognex standards. This full\-time, on\-site role in Bengaluru involves reviewing customer applications, selecting appropriate hardware and software, developing proof\-of\-concept demonstrations, and configuring systems for deployment. The position includes collaborating closely with sales teams, application engineers, and customer stakeholders to define project scope, create technical proposals, and ensure successful installation and commissioning. The Project Solution Engineer also provides technical training, documentation, and post\-deployment support, while continuously refining solutions based on performance data and customer feedback. Travel to customer sites may be required for project execution, troubleshooting, and relationship management.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Experience in machine vision, industrial automation, or robotics, with the ability to design and deploy integrated hardware and software solutions.
* Strong skills in system integration, including sensors, controllers, networking, and industrial communication protocols (such as Ethernet/IP, PROFINET, or Modbus).
* Proficiency in technical problem\-solving, diagnostics, and root\-cause analysis for complex automated systems.
* Ability to interpret engineering drawings, layouts, and mechanical or electrical schematics for solution design and deployment.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills for working with cross\-functional teams and presenting solutions to customers.
* Experience managing technical projects, including requirements gathering, planning, documentation, and coordination with internal and external stakeholders.
* Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field; advanced degrees or relevant certifications are a plus.
* Background in manufacturing or logistics environments is beneficial, especially in automated inspection, quality control, or material handling systems.
* Ability to work on\-site in Bengaluru and travel to customer locations as needed.

Join our dynamic Solutions Engineer team at Cisco, where you will collaborate with seasoned professionals dedicated to driving technical sales perfection and improving customer engagement. Be part of a supportive environment that fosters growth, teamwork, and impactful contributions to Cisco’s success.
  
  

Your Impact
  
As a Solutions Engineer you will orchestrate involvement of all technical activities and resources, holding accountabilities for all opportunities within assigned account(s) and provide architectural perspective across the Cisco product portfolio, including software and services.
  
  

* Technical sales professional serving as a Technology/Product/Solution consultant.

* Educate customer on Cisco differentiation and establish technical leadership of Cisco as a brand.

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Deep understanding of major cloud computing platforms, with specific expertise in Cisco’s cloud portfolio to design scalable, secure, and cost\-effective multi\-domain solutions.
* Ability to build highly tailored technical architectures that counter competitive technologies and clearly demonstrate Cisco’s brand differentiation to clients.
* Hands\-on experience using network automation and orchestration tools to optimize deployment, management, and operational efficiency across network and collaboration solutions.
* Strong track record of building technical relationships across diverse teams, including Engineering, Account Management, Business Units (BUs), and external Partners.


Why Cisco?
  
  

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

8aafbec9.title: Distinguished Engineer, Switch Architect
8aafbec9.description:
**About Marvell**


Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities.


At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead.

**Your Team, Your Impact**


Marvell’s Cloud Data Center Group designs and delivers the advanced interconnect architectures that serve as the backbone of modern computing. Within this group, the Teralynx Switch Architecture Team defines the architecture of Marvell’s future\-forward switch ASICs—solutions engineered for hyperscale cloud environments, massive east\-west traffic, and the unique challenges of AI workloads.  

  

This team shapes product definition, behavioral modeling, device performance modeling, and architectural validation. We work at the bleeding edge of semiconductor innovation, influencing industry standards and enabling the compute fabrics of tomorrow.**What You Can Expect**


Why Marvell  

* Work at the center of AI\-driven semiconductor innovation, shaping architectures that industry leaders will rely on for the next decade.
* Influence standards and ecosystems that define where the industry is going—not just where it is.
* Collaborate with high\-caliber engineering peers solving some of the largest\-scale data networking challenges on earth.
* Thrive in an environment where ideas are explored deeply, innovation is rewarded, and technical excellence drives impact.

As a **Distinguished Engineer**, you will be one of the most influential technical minds in Marvell’s switch strategy. You will own major architectural decisions that directly impact how hyperscale operators and AI clusters connect, scale, and evolve.


Your work will help guide the future direction of Marvell technology—delivering breakthroughs in performance, efficiency, and scalability that shape entire markets.

**What You Can Expect**

* Define architecture for Marvell’s **next\-generation AI networking switch ASICs** designed for hyperscale cloud and ML/AI\-driven workloads.
* Anticipate and analyze emerging technology trends, influencing long\-term roadmap and architectural direction.
* Contribute to the development of industry standards including **Ultra Ethernet** and **Ultra Accelerator Link (UAL)**.
* Create and maintain architectural and performance models to evaluate trade\-offs in latency, power, bandwidth, and scalability.
* Collaborate with silicon, software, systems, and product teams to drive holistic architectural alignment.
* Document architecture concepts, specifications, performance analyses, and modeling methodologies.
* Represent Marvell in standards bodies, research consortiums, and strategic customer discussions.
* Provide architectural mentorship and leadership to engineering teams across the organization.

**What We're Looking For**

* BS with **15\+ years**, MS with **10\+ years**, or PhD with **8\+ years** in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
* Extensive experience defining and architecting **large\-scale ASICs** and complex networking semiconductor architectures.

**Technical Expertise**

* Deep architectural understanding of:
	+ High\-speed interconnects and Ethernet protocols
	+ Traffic management architectures and packet processing
	+ Scaling networks in AI training and inference fabrics
* Proven hands\-on experience with **performance modeling**, simulation, and architectural trade\-off analysis.
* Proficiency in **C/C\+\+**, **Python**, and modeling environments.
* Experience contributing to or leading standards development is highly valued.

**Leadership \& Influence**

* Strong conceptual thinking and architectural innovation capabilities.
* Collaborative leadership style; ability to work across silicon, systems, software, and customer engineering teams.
* Exceptional communication skills; able to convey complex architectural concepts to technical and executive audiences.
* Demonstrated experience mentoring and influencing engineering talent and product direction.


This role is eligible to participate in Marvell's bonus and equity plans, including a new hire equity grant and annual equity refreshers, ensuring you are rewarded for your contributions and remain invested in the company's long\-term success.
**Additional Compensation and Benefit Elements**


With competitive compensation and great benefits, you will enjoy our workstyle within an environment of shared collaboration, transparency, and inclusivity. We’re dedicated to giving our people the tools and resources they need to succeed in doing work that matters, and to grow and develop with us. For additional information on what it’s like to work at Marvell, visit our Careers page.


All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status.

**Interview Integrity**


To support fair and authentic hiring practices, candidates are not permitted to use AI tools (such as transcription apps, real\-time answer generators like ChatGPT or Copilot, or automated note\-taking bots) during interviews.


These tools must not be used to record, assist with, or enhance responses in any way. Our interviews are designed to evaluate your individual experience, thought process, and communication skills in real time. Use of AI tools without prior instruction from the interviewer will result in disqualification from the hiring process.

**This position may require access to technology and/or software subject to U.S. export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). As such, applicants must be eligible to access export\-controlled information as defined under applicable law. Marvell may be required to obtain export licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce and/or the U.S. Department of State. Except for U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents, or protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3\), all applicants may be subject to an export license review process prior to employment.**

e84abf62.title: Systems Architect - Cloud AIOps
e84abf62.description:
We are seeking an experienced
 **Systems Architect \- Cloud AIOps** 
 to design and evolve next\-generation cloud platforms where AI\-driven intelligence is embedded as a foundational design principle. In this role, you will shape AI\-enabled platform engineering strategies, lead AIOps architecture initiatives, and serve as a senior technical authority guiding enterprise modernization programs across cloud infrastructure and cloud\-native environments.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Architect and evolve cloud platforms (AWS or Azure) where AI\-driven intelligence is a foundational design principle, not an afterthought
* Define and drive AI\-enabled platform engineering strategy, integrating observability, telemetry pipelines, intelligent alerting, predictive insights, and automation
* Lead the design of AIOps architectures that combine monitoring data, logs, metrics, traces, and operational knowledge to support proactive operations
* Embed SRE principles (SLIs, SLOs, error budgets) into platform design and enable AI\-assisted reliability management
* Serve as a senior technical authority in customer\-facing engagements, architecture workshops, and RFP/RFI responses, articulating AI\-driven platform value
* For Cloud Infrastructure\-led engagements: architect AI\-ready landing zones, networking, IAM, hybrid connectivity, DR, and cost governance
* For Cloud Native\-led engagements: architect Kubernetes platforms, modernization initiatives, and cloud\-native runtime environments designed for intelligent operations
* Design and integrate AI\-assisted operational knowledge systems, including RAG\-based architectures, to accelerate root cause analysis and decision support
* Collaborate with data and ML teams to consume AI/ML capabilities for operations (anomaly detection, automated RCA, predictive capacity insights)
* Provide architectural guidance on LLM, vector stores, and RAG pipelines as platform components for operational and reliability use cases
* Mentor architects and senior engineers, establishing AI\-aware platform engineering standards across the organization


**Requirements**
* 13\-20 years of experience in cloud platform architecture and engineering
* For the Cloud Infrastructure path: expertise in enterprise landing zones, VPC/VNet design, and security \& IAM, along with hybrid/multi\-cloud connectivity
* For the Cloud Native path: proficiency in Kubernetes platforms (EKS/AKS), microservices modernization, and service mesh (Istio/Linkerd), including GitOps and container security
* Background in Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Ansible, and CloudFormation or ARM/Bicep
* Skills in CI/CD and platform automation with Jenkins, GitHub Actions, and GitLab CI
* Competency in automation and integration scripting with Python, Shell, and PowerShell
* Familiarity with observability stacks such as Prometheus, Grafana, and ELK/EFK, as well as OpenTelemetry, Datadog, AppDynamics, and New Relic
* Strong SRE foundations covering SLIs/SLOs, error budgets, incident automation, and postmortems
* Expertise in AIOps capabilities, including event correlation across telemetry sources, anomaly detection on metrics/logs/traces, automated remediation with intelligent runbooks, and predictive alerting and capacity insights
* Understanding of RAG architectures for operational knowledge retrieval and AI\-assisted decisioning
* Proven experience leading platform\-led modernization programs and influencing platform roadmaps at enterprise and portfolio levels
* Capability to assess legacy and cloud environments and define AI\-enabled target platform architectures, combining platform engineering, AI capabilities, and operational excellence
* Strong English communication skills (B2 level or higher)

9c47b8dd.title: Pre-sales Consultant, India
9c47b8dd.description:
BioCatch is the leader in Behavioral Biometrics, a technology that leverages machine learning to analyze an online user’s physical and cognitive digital behavior to protect individuals online. BioCatch’s mission is to unlock the power of behavior and deliver actionable insights to create a digital world where identity, trust, and ease coexist.Today, 32 of the world's largest 100 banks and 210 total financial institutions rely on BioCatch Connect™ to combat fraud, facilitate digital transformation, and grow customer relationships. BioCatch’s Client Innovation Board, an industry\-led initiative including American Express, Barclays, Citi Ventures, and National Australia Bank, helps BioCatch to identify creative and cutting\-edge ways to leverage the unique attributes of behavior for fraud prevention. With over a decade of analyzing data, more than 80 registered patents, and unparalleled experience, BioCatch continues to innovate to solve tomorrow’s problems. For more information, please visit www.biocatch.com. 
 



  





 We are looking for an exceptional individual to join our vibrant growing Sales organization as a Pre\-Sales Consultant. The role requires a strong technical and sales acumen, along with relevant industry expertise with particular focus on fraud and financial crime prevention in the Financial Services sector.
 



 The Pre\-Sales Consultant will collaborate with sales, professional services, product management, operations, and engineering to identify customer pain points, ensure product fit, and propose solutions that accurately address customer needs to exceed business decision maker's expectations.
 



 The candidate will understand BioCatch's business goals, and pair with sales account executives to support delivery of revenue by owning the value sell and technical win, before providing a seamless handover to the delivery team. 
 



  





**Location: Mumbai (preferred), anywhere in India** 




  
 



**RESPONSIBILITIES:** 




  




* Undertake detailed discovery with customers, to truly uncover their needs and the associated drivers, dependencies, and challenges.
* Deliver presentations, customized demos, working sessions and scoping meetings to technically qualify deals.
* Work with the customer solution architect to design solution, document, and socialize to acquire customer buy in.
* Provide guidance on how best to leverage BioCatch within the customer critical decision\-making process.
* Proactively scope and document the technical solution and project plan required to address prospective customer requirements.
* Coordinate with professional services, delivery, and engineering team to validate technical and commercial feasibility of proposed solution.
* Secure commitments from the customer’s technical staff to ensure the deal meets the technical requirements to close.
* Define Proof of Concepts with clear success criteria and ensure conversion by guiding the delivery team to meet the objectives.
* Support the development of the overall business case.
* Lead the response to RFIs and RFPs.
* Work with customer InfoSec and BioCatch technical team to successfully answer security questionnaires.
* Interact regularly with customers (both internal and external) to provide thought leadership, business expertise and guidance to the organization.
* Where required, attend conferences for speaking engagements, increase BioCatch profile, gather leads and to build personal brand.
* Stay up to date with emerging fraud and financial crime MOs, industry trends, regulations, and mechanisms to combat these within the industry.
* Maintain market awareness and contribute to competitor intelligence gathering.
* Build strong relationships with clients and be seen as a trusted advisor on fraud and financial crime risk solutions.



  

  




 Requirements:
 
  




* Native English speaker
* 8\+ years of pre\-sales engineering or consulting experience in the fraud, financial crime or related technology space working with top tier customers.
* A passion to work with innovative technology and an entrepreneurial attitude to develop a career with an international organisation.
* Preferred experience in enterprise architectures and AI solutions.
* Deep understanding and SME of the fraud prevention, AML and financial crime landscape.
* General understanding of security frameworks.
* Good technical awareness to aid sales discussions, ideally including an understanding of items such as operating systems (Linux), cloud computing (Azure, AWS), data types (CSV, XML, JSON), database technologies \& storage, API integrations, HTML, JavaScript, SDKs, SPA development.
* Basic understanding of analytical techniques and constraints of statistical modeling and Machine Learning algorithms.
* Outstanding oral and written communication skills; effectively communicate technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Strong presentation skills and required to create custom market facing presentations.
* Highly proficient analytical and problem\-solving skills to uncover the customer need/challenge using probing questions, draw valid conclusions and identify risks, whilst defining an appropriate solution.
* Travel required 20%\-30% of the time locally and internationally.

4b06c13a.title: DWP Solution Consultant
4b06c13a.description:
**JOB PURPOSE** 




 The DWP Solution Consultant is a technical presales and solutioning specialist who designs winning, deliverable, and commercially viable solutions across Teceze's Digital Workplace (DWP) portfolio, delivered under the ONEWORK™ experience\-led operating model. The role sits at the intersection of Sales, Delivery, and the Centre of Excellence (COE) — translating client requirements into differentiated solution designs across Intelligent Service Desk, Endpoint Engineering \& Modern Management, Digital Experience (DEX) \& Proactive Operations, AI \& Intelligent Automation, M365/Teams \& Copilot, Field \& Deskside Services, Device Lifecycle \& Depot Services, Smart Workplace \& AV, and Workplace Security \& Compliance. The Solution Consultant plays a critical role in RFP/RFI responses, client workshops, solution architecture, effort estimation and pricing, and in building reusable IP that strengthens Teceze's competitive position in the DWP market.
 



**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




**1\. Presales \& Solution Design** 



* Partner with Sales to qualify opportunities and understand client pain points, current\-state environment, and desired business/experience outcomes.
* Design end\-to\-end DWP solutions spanning one or more sub\-towers (Service Desk, Endpoint/UEM, DEX/AIOps, AI \& Automation, Collaboration, Field Services, Device Lifecycle, Smart Workplace/AV, Security) tailored to client needs.
* Lead or contribute to RFP/RFI/RFQ responses — solution narrative, service descriptions, org design, transition approach, staffing plans, and technology architecture.
* Develop solution architecture and technical diagrams articulating the ONEWORK™ operating model — shared data, integration, governance, knowledge, and AI orchestration across the client's environment.
* Build and deliver compelling client\-facing presentations, solution demonstrations, and proofs of concept (POCs) / proofs of value (POVs).
* Represent Teceze in client workshops, discovery sessions, and due\-diligence calls, acting as the credible technical voice of the DWP practice.



**2\. Commercial \& Effort Estimation** 



* Develop effort estimation, staffing pyramids, and delivery models (dedicated pods vs. shared pools, onshore/nearshore/offshore, follow\-the\-sun) for proposed solutions.
* Work with Sales and Finance to build costing and pricing models across commercial constructs — per\-user, per\-device, per\-ticket, managed service, and outcome\-based pricing.
* Support commercial negotiations by clarifying solution scope, assumptions, dependencies, and pricing rationale to clients and internal stakeholders.
* Ensure proposed solutions meet target gross margin and deliverability thresholds before submission, escalating risks to the Practice Head where needed.



**3\. Technical Leadership \& Centre of Excellence (COE) Contribution** 



* Stay current on the DWP platform ecosystem (ServiceNow, Microsoft Intune/Autopilot, Nexthink/1E, Azure OpenAI/Copilot Studio, UiPath/Power Automate, Entra ID/Defender, Blancco, and similar) and emerging trends in AI\-first, experience\-led workplace services.
* Contribute to the DWP Centre of Excellence (COE) by building reusable solution accelerators, reference architectures, estimation models, and demo assets.
* Champion innovation and differentiation — conversational AI, agentic automation, self\-heal AIOps, Copilot readiness/adoption, and governed/responsible AI practices — in every solution design.
* Ensure all proposed solutions align with XLA \+ SLA governance, ITIL 4 process design, persona\-based service design, and shift\-left economics.
* Mentor junior presales/solutions team members and support their technical and commercial upskilling.



**4\. Transition \& Delivery Enablement** 



* Support a smooth handover from Sales/Solutioning into Transition and Service Delivery, ensuring the solution as sold is deliverable as designed.
* Participate in solution walkthroughs and knowledge transfer with the Transition Manager and Service Delivery leads at deal closure.
* Validate that transition timelines (e.g., 4–6 week service desk stand\-up, two\-week field/depot mobilization) and staffing assumptions built into the proposal are realistic and achievable.
* Provide ongoing solution support during early life of an account, addressing scope clarifications and design queries as they arise.



**5\. Marketing \& Thought Leadership Support** 



* Partner with the Marketing team on collateral — case studies, whitepapers, solution briefs, webinars — that showcase DWP/ONEWORK™ capabilities and client outcomes.
* Represent Teceze at industry events, client roundtables, and analyst briefings as a subject\-matter expert on Digital Workplace services.
* Support the development of a quantified, baseline\-driven business case (experience, cost, agility, security, and sustainability value levers) used in client pursuits and marketing narratives.



**KEY RESULT AREAS (KRAS) / SUCCESS METRICS** 



* Win rate on proposals/RFPs supported, and quality/competitiveness of solution designs submitted.
* Solution accuracy — alignment between proposed solution/pricing and what is actually delivered post\-signing (low scope/margin leakage at transition).
* Speed and quality of RFP/RFI turnaround and POC/POV delivery.
* Reusable IP and accelerators contributed to the DWP Centre of Excellence.
* Client and internal stakeholder feedback on presales engagement quality.
* Contribution to marketing\-sourced pipeline and thought leadership output.



  





**CANDIDATE PROFILE** 




**Education \& Experience** 



* Bachelor's degree in Engineering/Computer Science/IT; relevant certifications (ITIL, PMP, Microsoft, ServiceNow, etc.) preferred.
* 6–12\+ years of overall experience in IT Infrastructure/Managed Services, with meaningful exposure to Digital Workplace/End User Computing services.
* 3\+ years in a technical presales, solution consulting, or solution architecture role, ideally within an IT services/managed services organization.
* Demonstrated experience responding to RFPs/RFIs and supporting large or complex deal pursuits.
* Exposure to global/enterprise clients across multiple geographies and industry verticals (e.g., Healthcare, Energy \& Utilities, Retail \& Hospitality).



**Skills \& Competencies** 



* Strong working knowledge across the DWP portfolio: Service Desk, Endpoint/UEM, DEX \& AIOps, AI \& Intelligent Automation, M365/Teams/Copilot, Field \& Deskside, Device Lifecycle/Depot, Smart Workplace \& AV, and Workplace Security.
* Hands\-on familiarity with relevant platforms — ServiceNow, Microsoft Intune/Autopilot/Copilot Studio, Nexthink/1E, Azure OpenAI, UiPath/Power Automate, Entra ID/Defender — sufficient to design and defend a solution technically.
* Strong commercial acumen — effort estimation, staffing/pricing models, and margin awareness.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to create and deliver compelling client\-facing presentations and proposals.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to translate ambiguous requirements into structured solution designs.
* Comfortable working under pursuit timelines, managing multiple concurrent opportunities.
* Collaborative mindset — able to work seamlessly across Sales, Delivery, COE, Transition, and Marketing.



  





**WHY JOIN TECEZE** 




 This role offers the opportunity to shape winning solutions for one of Teceze's flagship service lines, working closely with senior leadership across Sales, Delivery, and the Centre of Excellence. It combines technical depth, commercial exposure, and client\-facing visibility — ideal for someone who wants to grow into broader presales leadership or practice management within the Digital Workplace domain.

3abf43b9.title: Senior Pre-Sales Consultant - CyberSecurity
3abf43b9.description:
**About Gruve**
 Gruve is an innovative software services startup dedicated to transforming enterprises to AI powerhouses. We specialize in cybersecurity, customer experience, cloud infrastructure, and advanced technologies such as Large Language Models (LLMs). Our mission is to assist our customers in their business strategies utilizing their data to make more intelligent decisions. As a well\-funded early\-stage startup, Gruve offers a dynamic environment with strong customer and partner networks.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 The Senior Pre\-Sales Consultant (Cybersecurity) is a strategic, customer\-facing role responsible for driving solution design and technical sales across enterprise security engagements. This role requires a strong blend of cybersecurity expertise, presales experience, and consultative problem\-solving to translate complex customer requirements into scalable, multi\-layered security architectures. You will work closely with sales, OEMs, and delivery teams to enable deal success, influence customer decisions, and drive revenue growth. The ideal candidate is hands\-on, business\-aware, and capable of engaging stakeholders across technical and leadership levels.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead technical discovery and customer engagements to understand security challenges and requirements
* Design and present end\-to\-end cybersecurity solutions across SIEM, SOAR, XDR, NDR, SSE, NAC, WAF, and SOC services
* Deliver technical demos, workshops, and Proof of Concepts (PoCs) to validate solutions and drive deal progression
* Develop technical proposals, Statements of Work (SOWs), HLDs/LLDs, and solution documentation
* Support SOC and managed security services pre\-sales including use\-case design, onboarding models, and SLA definition
* Collaborate with sales, OEM partners, and delivery teams to align solutions with customer needs and business goals
* Drive RFP/RFI responses, competitive positioning, and solution differentiation in complex deals
* Act as a trusted advisor to customers by recommending best practices and guiding security transformation initiatives


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Networking, or related field
* 6–13 years of experience in cybersecurity pre\-sales, solution architecture, or security consulting roles
* Strong experience across SIEM, SOAR, XDR, NDR, NAC, WAF, SSE, SOC operations, and managed security services
* Solid understanding of networking fundamentals including routing, switching, firewalls, VPNs, and SD\-WAN
* Proven experience in designing security architectures, delivering PoCs, and conducting customer workshops
* Experience in handling RFP/RFI responses, technical proposals, and end\-to\-end presales lifecycle
* Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills across technical and business audiences
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work in fast\-paced, cross\-functional environments


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, CEH, Security\+, CySA\+, or OEM certifications (Palo Alto, Fortinet, Splunk, Elastic)
* Experience working with MSSPs, cybersecurity consulting firms, or OEM presales teams
* Strong understanding of compliance frameworks such as ISO 27001, NIST, GDPR, PCI\-DSS
* Experience designing SOC architectures, detection use cases, or managed security service models
* Exposure to multi\-vendor security environments and integration of diverse security technologies
* Experience engaging with CXO\-level stakeholders and influencing strategic security decisions
* Ability to mentor junior presales team members and contribute to sales enablement initiatives
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving mindset with focus on customer outcomes


**Why Gruve**
 At Gruve, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive and contribute their best work. If you’re passionate about technology and eager to make an impact, we’d love to hear from you.
   

  

 Gruve is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and thank all who apply; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

79e48726.title: Solution Engineer
79e48726.description:
**About Us**
 RZR Global is an AI company that builds advertising solutions to drive mobile revenue growth. We use AI to find audiences in a privacy\-first world using trillions of contextual bidding signals coupled with proprietary behavioral models. Our audience engagement platform includes a full\-service agency team and a Unified Creative Strategy that delivers ad creative ideation and execution. We have worked with hundreds of advertisers over 14 years and see 5M mobile ad requests per second from over 10B devices, driving performance for publishers and brands. The company is headquartered in San Francisco, CA, with offices in the United States, EMEA, and APAC.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 The Solution Engineer will act as the technical bridge between Sales, Customers, and Product/Engineering teams. The role supports both
 **pre\-sales technical consulting** 
 and
 **post\-sales solution deployment and support** 
 , ensuring successful adoption of Aarki’s advertising platform.
   

  

 The individual will help partners and advertisers integrate with Aarki’s DSP infrastructure, troubleshoot campaign or data issues, guide technical implementations, and provide technical insights that improve product adoption and customer success.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

**Pre\-Sales Support**
* Partner with Sales teams to provide technical consultation during advertiser and partner onboarding.
* Translate customer requirements into scalable technical solutions using Aarki’s platform.
* Conduct product demonstrations and explain platform capabilities to internal and external stakeholders.


**Post\-Sales Technical Support**
* Provide technical account management for advertisers and ecosystem partners.
* Troubleshoot campaign delivery, tracking, data ingestion, and integration issues.
* Ensure successful product adoption by guiding customers through integrations and technical setup.


**Technical Implementation**
* Support integrations with advertiser systems, data partners, attribution providers, and measurement vendors.
* Manage deployment of campaign features such as targeting, tracking pixels, audience ingestion, and reporting pipelines.


**Internal Collaboration**
* Act as liaison between Sales, Product, and Engineering teams.
* Escalate and document product issues impacting customer deployments.
* Provide field feedback to improve product capabilities.


**Customer Success Enablement**
* Monitor and analyze campaign performance and system metrics.
* Proactively identify optimization opportunities and technical improvements.
* Create documentation and best practices for technical implementations.


**Required Skills / Experience**
* 4 \- 6 years of experience in Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Technical Account Management, or other customer\-facing technical roles.
* Experience working with AdTech / MarTech platforms or similar data\-driven or real\-time systems is preferred. Basic understanding of programmatic advertising, DSP ecosystem, or similar distributed platforms is preferred.
* Familiarity with at least one programming language such as Python, Java, or JavaScript.
* Strong SQL skills for data analysis, debugging, and troubleshooting, along with experience in PostgreSQL or MySQL.
* Experience with APIs, data pipelines, and system integrations.
* Familiarity with attribution, audience targeting, or data onboarding workflows is a plus.
* Exposure to mobile apps, SDK integrations, or tracking implementations is preferred.
* Experience using logs, dashboards, or analytics tools for monitoring and debugging along with analytical thinking and structured problem\-solving ability.
* Customer\-first mindset with the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to work cross\-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams.

32e5341f.description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
 Job Category
   

  

 Sales
   

  

 Job Details
   

  

**About Salesforce**
 Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
   

  

 Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
   

  

 Role Overview

 In this role, you will lead the design and development of cutting\-edge prototypes, demonstrating the transformative power of data, analytics, AI, and software engineering to solve complex business challenges for our customers. Die Position
  
  

**\#Job Description:**  

The ERP \- SAP IT consultant leads independently complex SAP solution delivery from a technical standpoint. This role is responsible for the specification of the architecture and functionality a global or local IT solutions..
  
In addition, they advise business and IT stakeholders on technical topics and work alongside IT and business colleagues to drive Idea\-to\-Requirement and Requirement\-to\-Implementation processes in a technical consulting role.
  
This IT expert role will work within the ERP Product configuration and Sustainability team. This position includes the below mentioned tasks and responsibilities with main focus on SAP Product and REACH Compliance, SAP Product Safety and/or SAP S/4HANA for Product Compliance Software Solutions.
  
  

**Job Responsibilities:**  

Solutions/Services
  
  

* Designs and communicates high\-level structures to enable and guide the design and development of integrated solutions that meet current and future business needs.
* Demonstrates understanding of requirements gathering and is able to show how agreed requirements are addressed by the proposed solution
* Innovates and optimizes processes and methods within the domain to meet system or user requirements and develop new functionality
* Guides the development of, and modifications to, solution components to ensure that they take account of relevant architectures, strategies, policies, standards and practices and that existing and planned solution components remain compatible
* Leads cross\-solution architecture in the SAP environment.
* Coordinates and cooperates with a team of external consultants and developers for support processes, change management and DevOps setup.
* Works and cooperates with a team of external consultants and developers for change and incident management processes in either Waterfall, DevOps or Agile team configurations.


Standards
  
  

* Applies and implements process standards and actively participates in their introduction and rollout.
* Observes governance processes, highlights areas for improvement and assists in their implementation
* Implements appropriate framework and processes
* Uses tools and follows Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)
* Maintains appropriate documentation of tasks and activities performed as required by project and other authorities.
* Ensures dynamic collaboration with governance\& dedicated architecture bodies
* Supports new and established IT solutions by following ITIL rule sets (esp. incident and service management)


Know\-how
  
  

* Understands business processes governing the application and is able to establish strong links with other technical teams responsible for the application and product delivery.
* Develops business/technical critical knowledge within the area of expertise for the function.
* Ensures alignment to defined technology roadmap among cross functional teams.
* Assists in the development of others by coaching and sharing his/her experiences and knowledge in the field of expertise.
* Supports the implementation of projects within the area of technical expertise, contributes to the implementation planning.
* Where requested supports Maintenance and Support activities e.g. for technical implementations or Change Management processes in a Waterfall, Agile or DevOps setup.
* Acts as IT consultant to Product Owners / Product Manager(s) (e.g. input to technical process flows, requirements, functionality gap analysis).
* Helps in defining testing for System and User Acceptance tests


Key Tasks\& Responsibilities
  
  

* Consults on conducting the IT landscape review
* Is responsible for further specify solution
* Consults on deciding preferred technology
* Consults on conduct feasibility study
* Is responsible for updating the solution architecture
* Is responsible for as\-is solution architecture impact analysis
* Is responsible for the development of the initial to be solution architecture
* Is responsible for specifying the solution architecture (Design)
* Is responsible for publishing the solution to the To\-Be IT landscape
* Consults on accessing the technical condition of solution
* Consults on updating lifecycle planning of solution, technology platforms and components
* Consults on assessing and planning changes
* Is responsible for requesting the IT landscape
* Is responsible for applying the IT landscape
* Is responsible for requesting the IT standard
* Is responsible for applying the IT standard


**Must\-Haves:**  

* Very good application knowledge in: SAP Product and REACH Compliance, SAP Product Safety and/orSAP S/4HANA for Product Compliance Software Solutions.
* 5\-6 years of professional IT experience directly in the relevant SAP module(s) mentioned above.
* Good understanding of SAP material master.
* Broad experience in the area of Product Safety, Product Compliance processes and corresponding regulatory context.
* Participated in at least 3 SAP implementation projects ( full cycle) in a similar role to the job description or equivalent experience.
* Able to lead/execute alignment meetings and discussions with business and IT stakeholders.
* At least BS in Computer Science, engineering or equivalent degree and/or experience.
* Advanced English reading, writing, listening and speaking.
* Able to work EMEA office hours.


Soft Skills
  
  

* Very strong communication skills at different levels (end users, stakeholders, team leads) in an assertive and collaborative manner.
* Analytical mindset, attention to detail.
* Excellent team player who enjoys collaboration, mentoring and knowledge sharing as well as self\-learning.


Special Requirements
  
  

* Flexibility to travel \~10%\-15% of time including outside of home country
* Working hours aligned with European office hours with potential shift to early morning or late afternoon to interact with colleagues in California or China.


**Advantages / Plus:**  

* IT knowledge on additional SAP modules.
* Project Management / Team coordination experience.
* Experience in working in a regulated environment and with Computer System Validation.
* Experience in stakeholder management / business consulting role.

 Customer obsessed for the long\-term

b687877b.description:

 Job Details
   

  

**About Salesforce**
 Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. **Role Overview**
*The Data Cloud Architect — Migration Factory is a cross\-track technical authority responsible for designing and governing the Salesforce Data Cloud implementation layer that underpins every migration wave within the Migration Factory. Bridging the gap between legacy data estates and the Salesforce unified customer platform, this role owns the end\-to\-end Data Cloud architecture — from ingestion stream design and identity resolution to unified profile modelling, segmentation activation and data readiness assessment for Agentforce. This position extends the readiness architecture into the Migration Factory delivery engine — ensuring every customer migrated across Marketing Cloud Next, Revenue Cloud, ITSM and Tableau Next tracks has a well\-governed, AI\-ready, unified data foundation in Salesforce Data Cloud from day one. The architect is equally responsible for the data migration discipline — owning data profiling, ETL strategy, transformation mapping, reconciliation standards and cutover data integrity across all migration tracks. As a member of the Migration Factory CoE, this role drives continuous improvement of data migration and Data Cloud accelerators, ensuring each wave delivers higher data quality and faster time\-to\-insight than the last.*
**Responsibilities**
* Data Cloud Architecture — Cross\-Track Ownership: Design the Salesforce Data Cloud architecture that serves as the unified data foundation for all Migration Factory tracks — owning data stream configuration, identity resolution rules, unified profile schema, data lake object (DLO/DMO) design, calculated insights and segmentation activation to downstream clouds.
* Data Readiness Assessment: Lead data readiness assessments for every incoming migration wave — profiling source system data estates across Marketing Cloud, CPQ/Billing, ITSM and BI platforms to identify data quality gaps, schema mismatches, consent record completeness and AI\-readiness of the data for Agentforce activation.
* Agentforce Data Readiness: Design the data architecture that makes migrated customer data AI\-ready for Agentforce — ensuring unified profiles, grounding data, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) context and structured data actions are correctly configured in Data Cloud and available to Agentforce agents post\-migration.
* Data Migration Strategy — Factory\-Wide: Own the cross\-track data migration methodology for the Migration Factory — defining standards for data profiling, ETL pipeline design, transformation mapping, staging area architecture, bulk load sequencing, cutover window design, dry run execution and reconciliation sign\-off across all five tracks.
* ETL \& Integration Pipeline Design: Architect ETL and data integration pipelines for migrating high\-volume source system data into Salesforce objects and Data Cloud — selecting appropriate tools (Informatica, Talend, MuleSoft, Azure Data Factory, AWS Glue) based on source system, volume and transformation complexity.
* Identity Resolution Design: Design and implement Salesforce Data Cloud identity resolution rulesets — defining match rules, reconciliation rules and individual/household profile merge strategies for migrated customer data from multiple legacy source systems.
* Consent \& Compliance Architecture: Architect the consent data migration strategy across all tracks — ensuring GDPR, CAN\-SPAM, CASL and POPI consent records, suppression lists and data processing agreements are correctly migrated into Data Cloud and propagated to activation targets including Marketing Cloud Next.
* Data Quality \& Validation Framework: Design and enforce the factory\-wide data quality framework — defining validation rules, anomaly detection thresholds, reconciliation counts, completeness checks and data quality warning standards in Data Cloud and Tableau Next post\-migration.
* Data Cloud Product Expertise \& Roadmap: Maintain deep, current knowledge of Salesforce Data Cloud product capabilities, roadmap, feature releases and best practices — translating new product capabilities into updated factory playbooks and delivery standards.
* Cross\-Track Collaboration: Work closely with the Marketing Cloud Next, Revenue Cloud, ITSM, Tableau Next and DevOps Track Architects — ensuring Data Cloud integration points, data stream dependencies and unified profile activation are correctly wired into each track's delivery plan and cutover sequence.
* Trusted Advisor to Clients: Serve as the senior data architecture advisor to client CDOs, Data Engineering leads and Enterprise Architects — articulating the vision for a unified, AI\-ready data platform built on Salesforce Data Cloud as the outcome of the migration programme.
* Factory Accelerator Development: Build and maintain the Data Cloud migration accelerator library — data stream templates, DLO/DMO schema blueprints, identity resolution config guides, consent migration playbooks, ETL pipeline templates, reconciliation scripts and data quality dashboards — as reusable factory assets.
* Platform Development for Factory Tooling: Design and build Apex\-based Data Cloud API callout frameworks, batch data validation utilities and LWC\-based data reconciliation dashboards deployed on the Salesforce platform to support factory data migration operations.
* Continuous Improvement — Factory Feedback: Capture Data Cloud and data migration lessons learned after every wave, feeding structured improvements back into the MDLC Phase 7 Factory Feedback loop — driving measurable reduction in data migration effort, defect rate and cutover duration wave\-over\-wave.


**Core Technical Skills — Must Have**
* Salesforce Data Cloud — Deep Expertise: Advanced hands\-on knowledge of Data Cloud — data streams, data lake objects (DLO), data model objects (DMO), identity resolution, unified profiles, calculated insights, segmentation, activation targets and Data Cloud APIs.
* Agentforce Data Readiness: Understanding of how Data Cloud unified profiles, grounding data, structured data actions and retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) context feed Agentforce agents — and how to design the data architecture to make migrated data AI\-ready.
* Data Migration Methodology: Proven expertise in end\-to\-end enterprise data migration — data profiling, ETL pipeline design, transformation mapping, staging architecture, bulk load sequencing, dry run execution, reconciliation and cutover planning across high\-volume source systems.
* ETL \& Data Integration Tools: Hands\-on experience with at least two ETL/integration tools — Informatica Cloud (IDMC), Talend, MuleSoft, Azure Data Factory, AWS Glue, Fivetran or similar — for large\-scale data extraction, transformation and load into Salesforce and Data Cloud.
* Identity Resolution Design: Experience designing Data Cloud identity resolution rulesets — match rules, reconciliation rules, individual/household profile merge logic and deduplication strategies for multi\-source customer data estates.
* Consent \& Compliance Data Architecture: Expert knowledge of consent data migration — GDPR, CAN\-SPAM, CASL, POPI — and how to architect consent record migration, preference data flows and suppression list propagation within Data Cloud and to activation targets.
* Data Architecture \& Modelling: Strong understanding of relational and dimensional data modelling, star/snowflake schemas, canonical data model design, ERD development and Large Data Volume (LDV) strategies for Salesforce platform objects and Data Cloud DMOs.
* Salesforce Platform \& API Development: Ability to write Apex Batch classes, REST callout frameworks and LWC data validation tools for factory migration operations. Experience with Salesforce Bulk API 2\.0, Composite API and Data Cloud Ingestion API for high\-volume data operations.
* Data Quality \& Reconciliation: Expertise in designing data quality frameworks — validation rules, anomaly detection, completeness checks, reconciliation count matching and data quality warning configuration in Salesforce and Tableau Next post\-migration.
* Integration Architecture: Understanding of enterprise integration patterns — event\-driven architecture, API\-led connectivity, pub/sub messaging and CDC (change data capture) — relevant to migrating real\-time data streams into Data Cloud from legacy source systems.
* Platform Security \& Data Governance: Knowledge of Data Cloud data governance — data spaces, field\-level security, consent API, data sensitivity labels and role\-based access — and how to apply compliance\-aligned governance for migrated customer data estates.
* Platform Development: Proficiency in Apex Triggers, Batch Apex, Schedulable classes, Governor Limit management and Apex Test Classes — combined with ability to build LWC dashboards and Salesforce Flow automations as internal factory tooling for data validation and migration progress monitoring.


**Preferred Skills — Good To Have**
* Hands\-on experience with Salesforce Data Cloud Ingestion API, Streaming API and Calculated Insights API for real\-time data activation
* Knowledge of zero\-copy data federation — Snowflake Data Sharing, Databricks Delta Sharing and BigQuery Omni — as Data Cloud data sources without physical data movement
* Experience with dbt (data build tool) for upstream data transformation and semantic layer design feeding Data Cloud data streams
* Familiarity with Customer Data Platform (CDP) migrations — migrating from Segment, Tealium, mParticle, Treasure Data or Lytics to Salesforce Data Cloud
* Understanding of Salesforce Marketing Cloud Next \+ Data Cloud activation patterns for AI\-personalised journeys post\-migration
* Experience with master data management (MDM) platforms — Informatica MDM, Reltio, Stibo — as source systems for identity resolution seeding in Data Cloud
* Knowledge of Apache Kafka, AWS Kinesis or Azure Event Hub for streaming data ingestion into Data Cloud via Ingestion API
* Familiarity with data mesh architecture principles and how federated data ownership models affect Data Cloud data stream design
* Experience with Salesforce Tableau Next as a Data Cloud visualisation and data quality monitoring layer post\-migration


**Experience Requirements**
* 8–14 years of experience in data architecture, data engineering and Salesforce platform solutions
* 5\+ years of hands\-on Salesforce Data Cloud (or legacy Salesforce CDP) implementation experience
* 4\+ years of enterprise data migration experience — end\-to\-end ownership of data profiling, ETL, transformation and cutover for large\-scale programmes (10M\+ records)
* Demonstrated experience delivering Data Cloud implementations that serve as the unified customer data foundation for multi\-cloud Salesforce programmes
* Proven experience working within a programme delivery model — collaborating with multiple track architects, data engineers and client data teams concurrently
* Experience with Agentforce data readiness — configuring Data Cloud to support Agentforce agent grounding, structured data actions and retrieval\-augmented generation


 SALESFORCE \& PLATFORM CERTIFICATIONS
   

  

* Salesforce Data Cloud Consultant (Required)
* Salesforce Certified Data Architect (Required)
* Salesforce Application Architect (Required)
* Agentforce Specialist (Required)
* Salesforce Marketing Cloud Consultant (Preferred)

* Data Migration Authority: Recognised expert in enterprise data migration — able to set and enforce data profiling, ETL, transformation and reconciliation standards across multiple concurrent migration tracks within the factory.
* Agentforce / AI\-Ready Data Design: Deep understanding of how Data Cloud unified profiles, grounding data and structured data actions enable Agentforce — able to design data architectures that make every migrated customer AI\-ready from day one.
* Cross\-Track Collaboration: Comfortable working alongside Marketing Cloud Next, Revenue Cloud, ITSM and Tableau Next Track Architects — providing Data Cloud integration guidance without owning their track delivery.

0466f61d.title: Project Manager / Engagement Manager - APAC Region - Enterprise
0466f61d.description:
**About the Company:**




 Emeritus is committed to teaching the skills of the future by making high\-quality education accessible and affordable to individuals, companies, and governments around the world. It does this by collaborating with more than 65 top\-tier universities across the United States, Europe, Latin America, Southeast Asia, India and China. Emeritus’ short courses, degree programs, professional certificates, and senior executive programs help individuals learn new skills and transform their lives, companies and organizations. Its unique model of state\-of\-the\-art technology, curriculum innovation, and hands\-on instruction from senior faculty, mentors and coaches has educated more than 250,000 individuals across 80\+ countries.
 



  





 Founded in 2015, Emeritus, part of Eruditus Group, has more than 2,000 employees globally and offices in Mumbai, New Delhi, Shanghai, Singapore, Palo Alto, Mexico City, New York, Boston, London, and Dubai. Following its $650 million Series E funding round in August 2021, the Company is valued at $3\.2 billion, and is backed by Accel, SoftBank Vision Fund 2, the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative, Leeds Illuminate, Prosus Ventures, Sequoia Capital India, and Bertelsmann.
 



  





**Role Overview:**




 We are looking for a highly agile, tech\-enabled, and client\-centric Project Manager / Engagement Manager to lead complex learning and leadership development engagements for global clients across the European region.
 



  





 This role goes beyond traditional program coordination and requires an individual who can independently manage high\-velocity, multi\-stakeholder, technology\-driven delivery environments while partnering credibly with senior client stakeholders.
 



 The ideal candidate combines strong project management discipline, operational ownership, stakeholder management, and modern technology fluency, including comfort with AI\-enabled workflows, digital collaboration platforms, and data\-driven decision\-making.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:**




  





**Client \& Stakeholder Management**
